title: DIOR Homme Sport Very Cool Spray for Men
body_html:
Very Cool Spray: the iconic fresh Dior Homme Sport Eau de Toilette comes in an elegant, unbreakable bottle with a powerful spray. A Very Cool Spray that encourages free and uninhibited fragrance application at any time of day.


"I adapted Dior Homme Sport to suit this new type of spray. Its unique* amplitude through the misting diffusion of micro-droplets has a physical effect on the fragrance. This innovative packaging had an influence on my composition. It was an unexpected challenge that intrigued and interested me." - François Demachy, Dior Perfumer-Creator.
* At Dior.

OLFACTORY DESCRIPTION:
Essence of Italian Citron
Cultivated in Italy since Roman times, this large citrus fruit is similar to lemon with highly fragrant yellowy-green pulp. Citron essence, which gives Dior Homme Sport all its freshness and bite, is obtained by an extraction process.

Pink Pepper extract
The fruit of the "Pepper Tree" is used as a spice known as "Pink Berry" or "Pink Pepper". Growing in clusters, its berries emit an intense freshness. Pink Pepper extract is obtained using an innovative extraction process that allows the peppercorn to retain its full aroma.

Vetiver
At the heart of Dior Homme Sport, Vetiver exerts an airy woody strength, relieved of its earthy notes. The "sport" spirit arises from the dialogue between the juicy vivacity of the top notes and the reassuring response of this noble ingredient imbued with a natural virility.

title: Prada L Homme Eau de Toilette for Men
body_html:
Immerse yourself in the world of L'Homme Prada, a fragrance that effortlessly blends contrasting elements and intricate layers to create a sensory masterpiece. This olfactory creation is a captivating symphony built upon the harmonious union of two iconic ingredients that define the essence of Prada: iris and amber.

With each inhale, the delicate and ethereal iris dances in perfect harmony with the warm and enveloping amber, creating a captivating contrast that is both alluring and captivating. These two ingredients, revered for their timeless elegance and allure, intertwine to create a fragrance that exudes sophistication and refinement.

L'Homme Prada is a modern interpretation of the classic Fougère genre, effortlessly capturing the essence of traditional masculine codes while infusing them with a contemporary twist. The bright and invigorating notes of neroli add a refreshing touch, intertwining with the sensual and aromatic geranium. As the fragrance settles, the rich and earthy patchouli reveals its depth, adding a touch of intrigue and allure to the composition.

Every aspect of L'Homme Prada is carefully crafted to embody the essence of Prada's vision of modern masculinity. It is a fragrance that effortlessly blends tradition with innovation, embracing the duality of strength and sensuality, and captivating all who encounter its intoxicating aroma.

Step into the world of L'Homme Prada and experience the timeless elegance and captivating allure of this extraordinary fragrance, where each layer reveals a new facet of its multifaceted personality.

title: Michael Kors Wonderlust
body_html:
Imagine being able to capture your exotic holiday in a bottle. Michael Kors Wonderlust Eau de Parfum for women is exactly that – full of warm sand on the coast of a blue sea which tickles your toes and enhances the magic of a perfect summer day. Join this fragrance on a journey to beauty, spontaneity, and sensuality.

  • sweet gourmand oriental-floral fragrance
  • Eau de Parfum for women who love luxury fragrance
  • wonderful for warm days

Composition of the fragrance
The big adventure of the senses starts very quiet and calm. First, you’ll notice the sweet aroma of almond milk, followed by spicy and sweet dianthus flower with its deep red colour reminiscent of corals hidden at the bottom of the ocean. The final stretch of your journey will bring you to the Indian ocean thanks to the sweet aroma of sandalwood obtained from trees in Sri Lanka.

Story of the fragrance
The luxurious bottle of Michael Kors Wonderlust with its sensual curves and gold accents looks as if bathed in hot sunlight. It represents elegance, luxury, and a carefree spirit – all of the elements of the perfect summer holiday.

This fragrance was introduced in 2016 with the model Gigi Hadid serving as its ambassador. The advertising campaign for this Eau de Parfum was shot on the beaches and in the blue waters of the British Turks and Caicos Islands.

Top notes
Almond Milk, Pink Pepper, Bergamot

Middle notes
Heliotrope, Pink Dianthus

Base notes
Benzoin, Sandalwood

The scent of the Hermès girls, a daring fragrance woven with striking ginger and sensual tuberose. A floral, spicy and oriental eau de parfum.

"It is with young women in mind, by observing their lives, that I created Twilly d’Hermès. Free, bold, connected, mischievous and irreverent, they turn expectation on its head, swim against the tide, impose their own rhythm, invent a brand new tempo." Christine Nagel

body_html:
The vivid and abundant freshness of neroli accentuated with notes of saffron.
Bottle with removable pump.

"Whereas there’s usually very little neroli in fragrances, I used an abundance of it, out of love, out of the ordinary." Jean-Claude Ellena.

With Eau de néroli doré, his fifth creation in the Colognes family, Jean-Claude Ellena has given full voice to neroli, the essence extracted from orange blossom so called in homage to Princess Nerola who perfumed her gloves with it. He also added saffron to heighten its lively, enveloping freshness.

title: Hermes Eau De Narcisse Bleu Eau de Cologne for Men
body_html:
The mysterious freshness of narcissus faceted with notes of orange blossom.

“An utterly free creation in which I worked specifically to express the tactile nature of a raw material.” Jean-Claude Ellena

An ode to a raw material endlessly reflected back by playing on its salient features, Eau de narcisse bleu is an unprecedented homage to freshness. An exercise in style that tames the sense of touch, faceted by orange blossom and galbanum.
This novella is written in a contemporary, very individual hand, creating a muted contrast between the dense textured note of narcissus and the delicacy of a woody accord.

The Colognes collection reflects reflects the house of Hermès’ art of living. Generous, figurative expressions of simple, sparkling pleasures, each Hermès cologne is an olfactory snapshot.

Olfactory emotion: Fresh, Delicate
Main raw materials: Narcissus, Orange blossom, Bergamot

At the forefront of this aromatic symphony, the vibrant essence of green mandarin envelops the senses, infusing the composition with an invigorating and zesty embrace. Cool Water Intense becomes your ultimate ode to freshness, an irresistible call that awakens the senses and beckons you to immerse yourself in its alluring depths. Its dynamic composition evokes a sense of liberation and adventure, inviting you to embrace the essence of life's pleasures and revel in the art of seduction.

Indulge in the sublime fusion of nature's finest ingredients and the artistry of perfumery. Cool Water Intense is a testament to Davidoff's commitment to craftsmanship and innovation, capturing the spirit of contemporary elegance and timeless allure. It is a fragrance that embodies the power of nature, the allure of intensity, and the irresistible charm of those who dare to embrace their true desires.

title: Guerlain L' Homme Ideal Eau de Toilette for Men
body_html:
Guerlain decodes men's desires and captures their ideal in the form of L'Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette. This fragrance embodies the essence of an ideal man, centered around a transcendent almond note that runs through all layers of the composition, drawing inspiration from Guerlain's iconic fragrance Jicky.

L'Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette is built upon three accords, each representing a different aspect of the ideal man:

1. The intelligence accord: It opens with a sparkling and perfectly fresh top note, combining citrus notes, rosemary, and orange blossom. This vibrant and invigorating blend creates an initial impression of energy and sophistication.

2. The beauty accord: At the heart of the fragrance, an incredibly sensual "amaretto" note takes center stage. This heart note revolves around a captivating almond and tonka bean duo. The almond brings a nutty, aromatic sweetness, while the tonka bean adds a creamy, gourmand touch. Together, they create a seductive and alluring aroma that exudes confidence and charm.

3. The strength accord: The base note of L'Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette is characterized by a woody and leather accord, giving the fragrance a definitive masculine edge. Indian vetiver, cedar, and leather are skillfully blended to provide a contemporary interpretation of traditional masculine elements. This base note adds depth, power, and a touch of ruggedness to the overall composition.

The combination of these three accords results in a harmonious and sophisticated fragrance that encapsulates the ideal man. L'Homme Idéal Eau de Toilette is a timeless and versatile scent that appeals to men who strive for intelligence, beauty, and strength.

The first fragrance of the brand, the Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau de Toilette, became an icon in perfume history. A simple design, cleanliness and a subtle touch of luxury characterise the fragrance, which resembles the sensual aroma of bare skin.

  • modern and feminine

Composition of the fragrance
The delicate and sophisticated Eau de Toilette For Her radiates from the skin with cleanliness and subtle elegance. The floral notes of orange blossom and osmanthus add feminine curves to the white musk. A drop of bergamot provides freshness, whereas amber and vanilla create a sensual warmth. Vetiver and patchouli add a hint of confidence and boldness which are hidden under the gentle feminine appearance.

Story of the fragrance
Designer Narciso Rodriguez wanted his first fragrance to capture contemporary female individuality and open-mindedness. Perfumers Christine Nagel and Francis Kurkdjian designed a fragrance full of contrasts. Transparent and at the same time opaque, gentle but bold. Rodriguez states that this fragrance is an integral part of him, just as his fashion creations are.

The elegant flacon has no unnecessary decoration and is coloured from the inside to bring out the lustre of clear glass. The mysterious black colour does not give anything away and entices us to uncover what hides within.

Rolling in Love is a "white" scent, evoking a sense of purity and simplicity. It unfolds with different textures along its trail, enveloping you in a sensual and comforting embrace. Almond milk adds a creamy and comforting element, creating a velvety smoothness. The delicate and powdery iris note enhances the romantic and intimate character of the fragrance, while the musk note adds a sensuous and captivating allure.

Together, these notes create an olfactory experience that captures the sensation of being in a cocoon of love, where every touch and every breath becomes an intoxicating and addictive pleasure. Rolling in Love is a fragrance that gets under your skin, allowing you to indulge in the pure and irresistible feeling of being deeply and passionately in love.

Indulge in the captivating allure of Rolling in Love, a fragrance that invites you to surrender to the intoxicating power of love and immerse yourself in an addictive and intimate cocoon.

title: Kilian Vodka on the Rocks Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
The fragrance Kilian Vodka on the Rocks draws its inspiration from the refreshing feeling of a vodka drink cooled by ice. It captures the essence of this invigorating experience, where a stream of silky clear liquid pours over ice, creating a sense of anticipation and curiosity.

The fragrance story of Vodka on the Rocks begins with an intriguing opening that awakens the senses. Cool spices, such as cardamom and coriander, intertwine with aldehydes, creating a crisp and refreshing sensation. This combination evokes the image of ice cracking beneath the liquid's surface, releasing a burst of coolness and intrigue.

As the fragrance develops, bitter rhubarb accord adds a touch of tangy and vibrant character, reminiscent of the bitter yet refreshing taste of a cocktail. A splash of clear rose and Lily of the Valley further enhances the aromatic bouquet, infusing a delicate floral nuance that harmonizes with the overall composition.

Adding depth and allure to the fragrance is an intoxicating leather undertone, created through the combination of sandalwood and oakmoss. This earthy and woody blend evokes a sense of sophistication and warmth, contrasting with the icy coolness of the opening.

Vodka on the Rocks is a fragrance that captures the essence of the refreshing and exhilarating experience of sipping a vodka drink cooled by ice. It invites you to indulge in the sensation of ice cracking, the cool spices, the tangy rhubarb, and the delicate floral notes, all embraced by the intoxicating warmth of leather. It is a fragrance that embodies sophistication, coolness, and a touch of mystery, offering a unique olfactory journey for the senses.

The interplay of floral notes, from the delicate opening to the intense floral bouquet, creates a captivating and unforgettable olfactory experience.

In this garden of good and evil, Good girl gone Bad invites you to explore the uninhibited side of your nature and revel in the allure of temptation. It is a fragrance that celebrates the multifaceted nature of women, capturing their ability to be both good and bad, innocent and seductive, all at once.

title: Calvin Klein Eternity Air Eau de Toilette for Men
body_html:
Calvin Klein Eternity Air Eau de Toilette for Men – A Crisp, Aquatic Expression of Modern Masculinity

Eternity Air for Men by Calvin Klein, launched in 2018, is a refreshing aromatic fougère fragrance that captures the essence of open skies and invigorating sea breezes. Designed for the contemporary man who appreciates clarity and vitality, this scent offers a light yet sophisticated profile suitable for daily wear.

Fragrance Profile

  • Top Notes: Sea notes, ozonic notes, juniper berries, and mandarin orange provide an immediate burst of freshness, evoking the sensation of a cool ocean breeze.

  • Heart Notes: Lavender, green apple, and violet leaf introduce a crisp, aromatic layer, adding depth and a touch of sweetness to the composition.

  • Base Notes: Seaweed, ambergris, and patchouli offer a subtle earthy finish, grounding the fragrance with a marine-infused warmth.

Performance and Occasion

Eternity Air for Men is noted for its moderate longevity, typically lasting around five to six hours on the skin, with a light projection that makes it ideal for close encounters and professional settings. Its airy and clean character makes it particularly well-suited for warm weather, daytime activities, and casual occasions.

Overall Impression

This fragrance stands out for its ability to blend freshness with subtle complexity, offering a modern twist on the classic Eternity line. It's a versatile addition to any fragrance collection, appealing to those who favor clean, aquatic scents with a refined edge.

title: Kilian Black Phantom - "MEMENTO MORI" Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
On turbulent seas, where danger lurks and mysteries abound, the pirate ship known as Kilian Black Phantom "Memento Mori" sails through the black waters, carrying its hidden treasures and captivating allure. At the heart of Black Phantom "Memento Mori" lies a captivating blend of rum accord from Martinique, reminiscent of the legendary "pirates' water," known for its rich and intoxicating aroma. This rum accord intertwines with the aroma of strong coffee, creating a bold and invigorating combination that awakens the senses. Yet, amidst the treacherous journey, there is a promise of sweet reward. Sugar cane and dark, creamy sandalwood emerge, offering a sense of comfort and solace amidst the trials. They assure us that even in the face of adversity, there is a glimmer of sweetness and tranquility to be found.

Black Phantom "Memento Mori" is a fragrance that captures the essence of a daring pirate adventure, where danger and excitement intertwine. It invites you to embrace the thrill of the unknown, to sail through the turbulent seas of life with courage, and to discover the hidden treasures that await those who dare to venture into the depths.

title: Kilian Angel Share Eau de Parfum for Men
body_html:
Kilian Hennessy's new fragrance, Angel's Share, is a deeply personal creation that pays homage to his heritage as an heir to the renowned French cognac-making family. Collaborating with French perfumer Benoit Lapouza, Kilian Hennessy delves into the depths of his family's expertise in cognac production to create a fragrance that captures the essence of "la part des anges" or "angels' share" – the evaporation of liquor in oak barrels during aging.

The perfume is a reflection of the craftsmanship and artistry found in both perfumery and cognac making. Just as a Master Perfumer skillfully combines accords and essences, a Master Blender expertly blends eaux-de-vie to create exceptional cognac. Angel's Share contains the essence of cognac derived from the liquor, imparting a natural caramel color and a rich, intoxicating character.

The fragrance opens with the luxurious aroma of cognac oil, immediately transporting you to the cellars where this precious spirit ages. The scent then unfolds with a blend of oak absolute, cinnamon essence, and Tonka bean absolute, evoking the woody and spicy facets of aged cognac. These notes create a warm and inviting ambiance, reminiscent of the barrels in the cellar.

As the fragrance develops, the long-lasting notes of sandalwood, praline, and vanilla emerge, adding a touch of sweetness and depth. These elements contribute to the delicious and alluring finish of Angel's Share, creating a rare concoction that only the angels should experience.

Angel's Share is a fragrance that invites you to indulge in the opulence and craftsmanship of cognac making. It captures the essence of time, tradition, and the mysterious evaporation that occurs during aging. With its rich and complex composition, Angel's Share is a testament to Kilian Hennessy's heritage and his passion for creating unique olfactory experiences.

title: Montale Aoud Damascus
body_html:
Montale Aoud Damascus is an Oriental fragrance for men and women with distinctive notes of rare oud wood and roses. It is part of the first French perfume line dedicated to rare oud wood, an ingredient with a resinous aroma. This line has been brought to the world by the Montale brand, which is characterised by its love of fragrances from the Orient and Arabia and its interest in their enchanting history. As with all the fragrances from the Montale brand, the greatly admired, yet somewhat enigmatic Pierre Montale has given the Aoud Damascus Eau de Parfum an original character evoking a miraculous elixir or a rare magical salve.

The Aoud Damascus Eau de Parfum constitutes the combination of the fascinating refinement of Arabian oud wood with the wonderful slightly acidic Damascus rose. The composition is exhorted to originality by the special incense and brilliant gurjun balsam. One of the two main aromatic components in the Aoud Damascus Eau de Parfum, the wood of the Aquilaria tree, also known as eagle wood, agarwood, oud, aoud or (in Arabic) oudh, is a fascinating material with a resinous aroma and the most expensive wood in the world, and has been used for centuries to make incense and (especially Arabian) perfumes. This truly regal ingredient, also sometimes called “liquid gold”, creates a popular duet with the unique Damascus rose in the composition of Montale Aoud Damascus.

Aoud Damascus offers a simple and yet complex fragrance. Pierre Montale has created a perfume which masterfully plays with the best of oud wood in combination with the distinctive, delicately sweet and deep Damascus rose, as if the time he spent in Saudi Arabia had imbued the brand’s founder and the creator of all the perfumes in its portfolio with the mysterious abilities of an oriental sorcerer. The two main components in the Aoud Damascus Eau de Parfum are accompanied in the composition by incense, gurjun balsam and safflower.

Like all of Pierre Montale’s fragrant creations, Aoud Damascus has been created using natural materials of the highest quality and in high concentrations which ensure that the fragrance has a long-lasting effect. Thanks to its intoxicating nature, authenticity and depth, Aoud Damascus is a suitable way to light up every day at any time of the year, day or night. Its warmth will be best appreciated in the cold months. It will appeal to men and women who like the combination of the fragrance of oud wood and roses in an original concept. Aoud Damascus should be tried by everybody who appreciates true quality and who likes to feel the breath of the magical history of the Orient upon them.

In addition to magical scents with masterfully balanced aromatic compositions, all the perfumes by Montale also come with captivating, original packaging. The design is enchanting thanks to its straightforward and pure elegance, which, in the case of Aoud Damascus, has been enhanced with the use of a matt metallic gold colour scheme, while the practical selection of the material also makes the flacon unique. Pierre Montale has made the original choice of aluminium, which provides the perfume with perfect protection.

Montale Aoud Damascus – an intoxicating ode to the Damascus rose.

title: Montale Boisé Vanillé
body_html:
Montale Boisé Vanillé is an oriental, vanilla fragrance for women. This eau de parfum by the French perfume producer, specific mainly due to its love for aromas of the Orient and Arabia and their magical history, offers a unique, complex, spicy and woody interpretation of vanilla. Just like all the fragrances by Montale, Boisé Vanillé was created by admired and rather mysterious Pierre Montale who made it original to evoke a magic potion or a precious miraculous ointment.

The aromatic composition of Montale Boisé Vanillé eau de parfum consists of chords of lemon, bergamot, lavender, pelargonium, cedar, iris, patchouli, tonka beans, pepper, and - of course - vanilla. Its aroma, merging the beautiful chord of vanilla with fresh and spicy, aromatic, and woody aspects and citrus and floral aspects, is slightly attractive, dark and thoughtful. Thanks to its floral heart, Boisé Vanillé is harmonious with a base of patchouli and with tonka beans making it sensual.

It looks like the founder of Montale brand and the creator of all the perfumes in its portfolio obtained mysterious skills of an oriental magician during his stay in Saudi Arabia. Pierre Montale created a unique interpretation of vanilla in which citrus and aromatic tones minimized the typical sweetness of vanilla while the dark spices and woody chords put it in an amazing contrast. Just like all the other perfumes by Pierre Montale, Boisé Vanillé is created from natural materials of the highest quality in high concentrations to provide long-lasting effects.

title: Dior Fahrenheit Eau de Toilette for Men

Dior Fahrenheit is a fragrance that embodies the essence of a man who stands alone against the majestic elements, fueled by an unwavering thirst for the absolute. It is a timeless and universal scent that goes beyond fleeting trends, carving its own path and leaving an indelible mark.


At the heart of Fahrenheit lies a distinctive and contrasting olfactory signature, crafted to captivate the senses. The fragrance opens with the invigorating freshness of Sicilian Mandarin, infusing a burst of vibrant citrus that awakens the senses and sets the stage for the olfactory journey ahead.

As the fragrance develops, a remarkable blend of masculine Wood and Leather notes emerges, creating a captivating and magnetic aura. The interplay between these elements adds depth and character to the composition, evoking a sense of strength and confidence.

A unique Violet accord further enhances the fragrance, infusing a touch of elegance and sophistication. The Violet note adds a floral facet to the composition, intertwining with the woody and leathery notes to create a harmonious and intriguing balance.

Fahrenheit leaves a powerful and lingering trail, making a statement that resonates long after its initial application. Its longevity ensures that the fragrance remains with you throughout the day, leaving an impression that is both memorable and captivating.

Fahrenheit is a fragrance that transcends time and trends, standing as a testament to its own distinct identity. It is a scent that speaks to the man who embraces his individuality, forging his own path with confidence and determination. With its unique blend of fresh citrus, masculine woods, leather, and a touch of floral elegance, Fahrenheit offers a truly remarkable olfactory experience.

title: Guerlain Shalimar Souffle de Parfum for Women
body_html:
Imagine being enveloped in a perfumed caress that transports you to a world of enchantment and allure. Such is the essence of Shalimar Souffle de Parfum, a light and captivating Eau de Parfum that reimagines the legendary Shalimar in a modern and enticing way.

Like a delicate breeze of citrus fruits, this fragrance opens with a refreshing burst that awakens the senses. The vibrant notes of citrus dance gracefully, infusing the air with a lively and invigorating energy. In the heart of the composition, the intoxicating essence of jasmine takes center stage, blooming like a fragrant flower in the moonlight. Its floral elegance captivates and enchants, evoking a sense of timeless beauty and grace.

As the fragrance settles, a veil of white musks delicately wraps around you, leaving a trail of softness and sensuality. These musky notes lend a touch of ethereal elegance, creating a sublime and intimate aura. And just when you think the olfactory journey couldn't get any more enticing, the warm and comforting embrace of vanilla emerges. Its sweet and inviting aroma adds a layer of depth and richness, weaving an irresistible tapestry of scent.

The tale behind Shalimar is as captivating as the fragrance itself. It transports us to a bygone era in India, where a love story of epic proportions unfolded. The emperor Shah Jahan, in his undying love for his beloved wife Mumtaz Mahal, created the magnificent gardens of Shalimar as a testament to their eternal bond. And as a crowning jewel, he built the Taj Mahal, a marvel admired by the world. Inspired by this extraordinary tale, Jacques Guerlain crafted the very first ambery fragrance, Shalimar, as an ode to love and beauty.

With Shalimar Souffle de Parfum, this timeless legacy is reimagined in a modern and enchanting way. It captures the essence of seduction and elegance, enveloping you in a perfumed caress that lingers delicately on your skin. Immerse yourself in the world of Shalimar, where citrus fruits, jasmine, white musks, and vanilla intertwine to create a symphony of scents that captivate the senses and leave an indelible impression.

Indulge in the magic of Shalimar Souffle de Parfum, and let its light and enchanting notes transport you to a realm of timeless beauty and seduction. Experience the allure of this modern interpretation of Shalimar, and embark on a journey filled with passion, elegance, and the lingering memory of a love that knows no bounds.

Mon Guerlain Eau de Parfum is a tribute to the heritage of Guerlain, embodying the brand's commitment to exceptional craftsmanship and the pursuit of timeless beauty. It is a fragrance that celebrates the essence of femininity, evoking a sense of confidence, allure, and grace.

The bottle design reflects the modern and elegant nature of the fragrance. The iconic Versace Medusa emblem is prominently featured on the cap, while the blue tint of the bottle exudes a sense of sophistication and allure.

In summary, Versace Pour Femme Dylan Blue is an alchemy of irresistible notes, creating a strong and sensuous fragrance for women. Its refreshing fruity opening, contemporary floral heart, and warm woody base come together harmoniously to embody the power and allure of femininity.

title: Mont Blanc Explorer Eau de Parfum for Men

Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum is indeed an invitation to embark on a fantastic olfactory journey, evoking a sense of adventure and exploration. Released by Montblanc, a renowned luxury brand, this fragrance combines various aromatic elements to create a unique and captivating experience.

At the core of Montblanc Explorer is the vibrant and citrusy Italian Bergamot. Its fresh and zesty notes provide a lively and invigorating opening to the fragrance. Complementing the bergamot, there are green and aromatic facets that add depth and complexity to the composition.

To further enhance the fragrance's depth, an exclusive Patchouli from Indonesia is incorporated. Patchouli adds a warm and slightly sweet earthiness to the composition, contributing to its woody and aromatic facets. It lends a sense of richness and exoticism to the overall scent profile.

The bottle design of Montblanc Explorer is elegant and distinctive. The glass bottle is adorned with the iconic Montblanc star, symbolizing the six glaciers of the highest mountain in Europe. This emblematic detail showcases the brand's heritage and commitment to craftsmanship.

Montblanc Explorer Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that embodies the spirit of adventure and exploration. Its unconventional blend of woody, aromatic, and leather accords creates a captivating and alluring scent. Whether you are venturing into uncharted territories or simply seeking an olfactory journey, Montblanc Explorer is designed to accompany you on your quest for new experiences.

With this fragrance, Guerlain invites you to embrace your seductive powers and unleash the irresistible qualities that define the ideal man.

L'Homme Idéal Eau de Parfum is a testament to Guerlain's expertise in perfumery, as well as their commitment to creating unique and unforgettable fragrances. It is a scent that celebrates the art of seduction and invites you to explore the depths of your own allure.

1. Origin & Botanical Identity
Sri Lankan Blue Lily, also known as Nil Manel, is the beautiful blue water lily (Nymphaea nouchali), native to the tropical waters of Sri Lanka. It is also recognized as the national flower of Sri Lanka.

2. Delicate & Distinctive Aroma
Its fragrance is fresh, aquatic, soft and floral, with subtle green, woody, slightly sweet and powdery nuances, creating an elegant and serene floral impression.

3. A Symbol of Sri Lankan Beauty
Deeply associated with Sri Lanka's natural beauty and cultural heritage, Blue Lily brings an authentic sense of island freshness, tranquility and exotic elegance to the fragrance.

4. Beautifully Versatile in Perfumery
Blue Lily blends beautifully with Jasmine, Rose, Neroli, Bergamot, Sandalwood, Oud, Musk, Amber and Vanilla, making it suitable for fresh, floral, woody and oriental compositions.

5. Perfect for a Signature Fragrance
As the main ingredient, Sri Lankan Blue Lily creates a luminous, sophisticated and memorable floral signature—ideal for a fragrance that feels fresh, luxurious, serene and distinctly exotic.

title: Faisal Abdul Rehman Brazilian Tonka Beans Eau De Parfum For Unisex
body_html:
Faisal Abdul Rehman Brazilian Tonka Beans Eau De Parfum For Unisex

Description

1. Origin & Botanical Name
Brazilian Tonka Bean, also known as Cumaru, is the dried seed of the Dipteryx odorata tree, native to the Amazon region of Brazil. It is prized in perfumery for its naturally rich and distinctive fragrance.

2. Rich & Irresistible Aroma
Tonka Bean offers a sweet, warm, creamy and slightly powdery aroma, with beautiful nuances of vanilla, almond, soft hay, tobacco and warm woods. Its comforting sweetness gives fragrances a luxurious and sophisticated character.

3. A Natural Touch of Warmth & Sweetness
Brazilian Tonka adds depth, smoothness and a warm gourmand character to fragrance compositions. It works particularly well to soften sharper notes and create a rich, rounded and inviting fragrance profile.

4. Excellent for Blending
Tonka Bean is highly versatile and blends beautifully with Oud, Sandalwood, Vanilla, Tobacco, Amber, Musk, Saffron, Rose and other oriental or woody notes. It is especially popular in perfumes, attars, fragrance oils and incense compositions.

5. Ideal for Premium Fragrance Creations
A favorite among perfumers looking for a warm, elegant and luxurious signature, Brazilian Tonka adds a beautiful finishing touch to both traditional and modern fragrance creations. Its sweet, creamy character makes it especially attractive for oriental, woody, gourmand and amber-style perfumes.

The dry-down is where the fragrance truly shines—rich, smoky, and grounding—with notes of palo santo, sandalwood, myrrh, benzoin, and vetiver, delivering a deep, resinous, and long-lasting trail.What makes Reasons stand out is its high 30% oil concentration and unique aging process, including a six-month maturation and double infusion with sandalwood and oakwood, resulting in exceptional richness and layered complexity.
Overall, this is a refined, contemplative, and artistic fragrance—perfect for those who appreciate niche perfumery, woody compositions, and subtle luxury with depth rather than loud projection.

Lacoste is a symbol of casual elegance, both in fashion and the world of fragrance. The brand was founded in 1933 by the famous tennis player René Lacoste, and at first focused solely on manufacturing sportswear. The French champion wanted to feel comfortable when playing while also feeling like a gentleman. Relaxation, simplicity and natural elegance are still reflected in Lacoste fashion and Lacoste perfume today.

The first Lacoste fragrance was launched in 1984, followed by entire perfume ranges for both men and women. Lacoste fragrances for men and women have mostly been inspired by a variety of sports. Lacoste fragrances have been symbols of casual elegance for several decades, making Lacoste one of the most famous fashion brands today.

title: Maison Fragrance World Cuero Pura Eau De Parfum For Men
body_html: French Avenue · Pura Collection · Smoky Leather · For Men Leather, smoke, and primal allure. Leather, incense and animal notes open into cade oil and labdanum over an isobutyl base — a dark, smoky, primal leather fragrance for men. French AvenueEau De Parfum70mlFor Men8–10 hrs LongevityPura Collection Scent FamilyLeatherSmokyAnimal NotesResinous About This Fragrance Maison Fragrance World French Avenue Cuero Pura (Spanish for 'pure leather') is an unapologetically dark, primal fragrance built around genuine leather authenticity. Rather than following a conventional pyramid, Cuero Pura presents its notes as a unified, rich blend: leather, incense, and animal notes combine immediately into something raw and atmospheric — sacred smoke meeting raw hide meeting something genuinely untamed. Cade oil is the technical heart of this composition — a rectified juniper tar oil traditionally used in leather tanning, giving Cuero Pura its authentic smoky-leathery character that distinguishes it from synthetic 'leather accord' fragrances. Labdanum adds warm, resinous amber depth while isobutyl rounds out the composition with a clean structural base. The result is a fragrance of genuine mystery and allure — dark, smoky, and completely uncompromising in its leather-forward identity. Dried red rose, cashmere and patchouli open into seaweed and musk — a stripped-back, atmospheric aquatic fragrance built on contrast. The opening of dried red rose, cashmere, and patchouli is immediately atmospheric: dried rose offers a faded, slightly powdery floral quality rather than fresh-petal brightness, while cashmere adds textile-soft warmth and patchouli grounds everything in earthy depth. The heart of seaweed and musk is where Aqua Pura earns its name — seaweed contributing a genuinely oceanic, mineral-salty character that is rare and distinctive in masculine perfumery, while musk provides the clean, skin-close warmth that ties the entire composition together. This contrast between dried florals and pure aquatic minerality is what makes Aqua Pura genuinely original — proof that 'less is more' when each ingredient is chosen with precision. Hugo Boss has become synonymous with luxury and high quality in men's fashion, accessories and cosmetics. Since its inception, it has been sought after for its high-quality fabrics and its German eye for detail and precision.

title: Rasasi Seen Sotoor Eau De Parfum For Unisex
body_html: Sotoor — Unisex Pear and guava luminosity, rose and honey warmth. Pear and guava open with fresh luscious fruitiness before honey, orange blossom and lily-of-the-valley create a dreamy floral heart. Musk, vanilla and oakmoss close with soft, warm elegance. Seen Sotoor — precious, luminous and utterly inviting. RasasiSotoor100mlUnisex6-8 hrs Longevity Scent FamilyFruityFloral About This Fragrance Rasasi Seen Sotoor, launched in 2017, is the first chapter of the Sotoor trilogy — Seen being the Arabic letter equivalent of 'S', representing the series' exploration of distinct fragrance personalities. Seen is described as fresh, luminous and precious — a fragrance that opens on lusciously inviting fruity notes and carries the wearer on a journey from bright fruitiness to warm floral elegance. The opening of pear and guava is immediately appealing — ripe, juicy and distinctly tropical without being heavy. The heart is where Seen Sotoor reveals its precious character: honey, orange blossom, lily-of-the-valley and rose create a dreamy, slightly opulent floral accord with a touch of sweetness from the honey. The base of musk, patchouli, vanilla and oakmoss grounds the luminous florals in warm, earthy depth — the oakmoss adding a classic, slightly mossy richness that gives Seen Sotoor an unexpected vintage elegance. body_html: Sotoor — Unisex Bergamot and lemon brilliance, jasmine and patchouli soul. Raa is described as an exuberant fresh floral perfume that reminds you of sunny skies — and the fragrance delivers precisely that bright, uplifting character from the first spray. The opening of bergamot and lemon is classically beautiful — sparkling, clean and immediately uplifting with a luminosity that brightens the spirit. Jasmine, nutmeg and lily-of-the-valley in the heart create a richly floral composition with the warmth of nutmeg adding unexpected spiced depth. The base of musk and patchouli is clean yet earthy — the patchouli providing grounding warmth without heaviness. Raa Sotoor is the most versatile and broadly appealing chapter of the trilogy. title: Rasasi Taa Sotoor Eau De Parfum For Unisex
body_html: Sotoor — Unisex Neroli and pink pepper, sea and warm amber. Neroli, lavender, pink pepper and cardamom open with an aromatic-floral complexity before orange blossom, sea notes and geranium create a marine-floral heart. Vanilla, amber, cedar and patchouli close with sweetly exotic, warm depth. RasasiSotoor100mlUnisex7-9 hrs Longevity Scent FamilyAromaticOriental About This Fragrance Rasasi Taa Sotoor, launched in 2017, is the final and most complex chapter of the Sotoor trilogy. Taa is the most complete of the three: an aromatic-marine-oriental composition that covers more olfactory ground than any other Sotoor fragrance. The opening of neroli, lavender, pink pepper and cardamom is tangy and multi-dimensional — the floral neroli and calming lavender meet the sharp bite of pink pepper and the warm spice of cardamom to create an immediately complex, sophisticated first impression. The heart introduces an inspired combination: orange blossom's delicate floral, sea notes' cool marine freshness, and the lemony-rosy character of geranium. The base of vanilla, amber, cedar and patchouli grounds everything in sweetly exotic, dark, warm and earthy depth. Nowadays, the Davidoff fragrance includes dozens of different scents, with leading perfumers working to create them. Clearly the biggest success has been the Davidoff Cool Water collection, which caused a minor revolution in the world of perfume. Zino Davidoff was himself a master of the art of life. He travelled the entire world; for Davidoff adventure and challenges happened every single day. All of this could be seen in his work. title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Ghawi Attar-15ml
body_html:

Description

The aroma is so pure, it promptly grabs your attention. A bottle that, even after a decade, is immediately identifiable.The first sensations of floral accords are sweet, not sickeningly saccharine but certainly a little sugary. The herby notes in Ghawi concentrated oil are full of freshness and contribute to the greenness of the perfume. A tiny proportion of Indian roses are collected from the regions of Kannauj and added to the depth of the heart of perfume, which improves its surroundings with its enticing aroma. Vanilla adds a kind of magic to the flavor while simultaneously drifting a tiny pinch of powdery synthetic notes into the scent.

Description

Haltane by Parfums de Marly is a Woody Aromatic fragrance for men. This is a new fragrance. Haltane was launched in 2021. "Haltane is a fragrance for a gentleman of today, inspired by the gentilhommes of the Chateau de Marly in the 18th century.” Julien Sprecher, Founder and Artistic Director of Parfums de Marly. Haltane is an original scent of both radiance and shadow. Its composition features a blend of rare and noble ingredients which revisit the tradition of 18th century French perfume making. Its dazzling freshness and herbal top notes quickly yield a warm and smooth sense of leather with a symphony of precious woods. Soft and sweet, escorted by saffron, its praline accord is an ultra-contemporary spin on the mythical oudwood. The most intense note in this masculine cologne is of course vetiver, with its woody-musty facets. Citruses are the next punch of flavor, and they shine bright against the spice of the Sichuan pepper that follows, with tart bergamot to tie the fragrance together. Deep, smooth, and full, this scent is a darker yet fresher interpretation of the original scent with strength, spice, and confidence. Nanshe by Nishane is a Amber Floral fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Nanshe was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Cécile Zarokian. NANSHE is the name of a Sumerian goddess of fertility, water, and social justice, who was believed to be the patroness of dreams and prophecy. He cared for orphans and widows, supervised justice, fresh water, birds and fish, fertility, and favored the prophets, giving them the ability to interpret dreams accurately.

Together with perfumer Cecile Zarokian, the main challenge was to create a fragrance that reflected the kind, compassionate, welcoming and wise attributes of this divine figure. His goal is to bring fertility for more positive vibes and souls to make the world a better and fairer place to live.A world where the forgotten, the poor, the lonely and the marginalized are cared for.
NANSHE’s motto is: “Be the owner of dreams and prophecy.”

Fragrance Notes

Middle Notes- Fruits, flowers, Rose Absolute, Sambac Jasmine Absolute, Ylang-Yang

Description

EGE / ΑΙΓΑΙΟ by Nishane is a Aromatic Spicy fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. EGE / ΑΙΓΑΙΟ was launched in 2020. The nose behind this fragrance is Ilias Ermenidis EGE / ΑΙΓΑΙΟ is a tribute to the Aegean Sea, an elongated inlet of the Mediterranean Sea located between the Greek and Anatolian peninsulas, which has been historically important, especially in regards to the civilization of ancient Greece, which inhabited the area around the the Aegean coast and the Aegean islands. The Aegean islands facilitated contact between the people of the area and between Europe and Asia.

EGE is the Turkish name for the sea that is derived from the Greek name ΑΙΓΑΙΟ. Having both names together as the perfume name (EGE / ΑΙΓΑΙΟ) is a deliberate choice by NISHANE in order to pay homage to the skies and culture shared by the Turks and Greeks who are the neighboring residents of the Aegean.

Fragrance Notes

Top Notes- Yuzu, Violet leaves, Anise

Middle Notes-Basil, Green cardamom, Mint

Base Notes- Olibanum, Liquorice

title: Amouage Figment Man Eau De Parfum
body_html:
Amouage Figment Man Eau De Parfum

Description

Figment Man by Amouage is a Amber Woody fragrance for men. Figment Man was launched in 2017.A new release from Amouage is always reason to celebrate, but when a fragrance as unique as Figment arrives, we can truly appreciate just how special the venerable Omani house can be. Rich with contrast, dreamlike in its serenity, Figment Man draws exquisite florals, woods and animalics together to create an utterly original, rapturously imaginative men’s scent that will challenge and delight in equal measure.

Opening with fresh, tranquil notes of lemon, geranium, and pink pepper, Figment then moves into a luminous heart of sandalwood that entwines dramatically with leather-inflected, smokily animalic elements evoking primal secrets and ancient traditions. As the base emerges, intoxicatingly balsamic strokes of labdanum and guaiac wed the earthly to the mystical with sublime grace. Inspired by the wondrous Kingdom of Bhutan, where the mountains meet the sky, Figment Man is an apt testament to one of the few places on earth where magic and mystery still reign.

Fragrance Notes

Top Notes- Geranium, Lemon and Pink Pepper

Middle Notes- Animal notes, Vetiver and Sandalwood

Base Notes- Earthy Notes, Labdanum and Guaiac Wood

Imagine sitting in solitude on the rugged, wide plains of the American West, firelight on your face, indigo-blue night skies above. There is nothing around save for the soft, desert wind. You. Are. Free. From this defining vision was born SANTAL 33: a perfume that touches the vast and wild universality of this dream... that intoxicates... It combines a mix of cardamom and notes of iris and violet, which crackle in the foula. Added to this smoking wood alloy (Australian sandalwood, cedarwood) are some spicy, leathery, musky notes, giving this perfume its signature and addictive comforting scent. Here is, in a few words, what SANTAL 33 is... An open fire…The soft drift of smoke…Where sensuality rises after the light has gone.

Fragrance Notes

Top Notes: Violet Accord, Cardamom.

Middle Notes: Iris, Ambrox.

Base Notes: Cedarwood, Leather, Sandalwood.

title: Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau De Toilette Vial 2ml Pack of 1
body_html:
Hermes Terre D'Hermes Eau De Toilette Vial 2ml Pack of 1

Description

Hermes Terre D'Hermes is a luxurious, slightly spicy fragrance for men. Succumb to the power and energy brought to you by this celebration of male ego.Pamper yourself with its strong, earthy tones of cedar wood and vetiver in combination with mild spices and a fresh breath of grapefruit. You'll fall in love with Terre D'Hermes for its uniqueness and grace which provides each man with the necessary amount of wildness and elegance.Enjoy the luxury by Hermes whose perfumes are easy to define as a combination of elegant classic with a modern tinge. And Hermes Terre D'Hermes is no different. Strenghten your ego and pamper your senses. Draw pure strength and energy Terre D'Hermes obtains from natural elements and become just irresistible!The French brand Herms has a very interesting history.

The company, founded in the 1830s by Thierry Herms, originally produced horse saddles, harnesses, and other riding equipment. Later, however, he started offering other leather products (handbags, belts, etc.), roofs for convertibles, watches, silk scarves, etc. and finally luxury menswear and womens cosmetics.It is hardly surprising that many of the Herms perfumes were inspired by the aroma of leather (which also adorns some of their perfume bottles). They are fresh, sensual, bold, and sophisticated and each of them is a true work of art created just to please your senses. Not surprisingly, they have received many awards and are used by Hollywood stars: Jessica Alba, Gwyneth Paltrow, Sofia Vergara, and more. Originality, harmony, genius thats Herms!

Fragrance Notes:

Top Notes: Grapefruit, Orange

Middle Notes: Pelargonium, Pepper

Base Notes: Benzoin, Cedar, Patchouli, Vetiver

Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver Cologne by Hermes, Citrus woody and aromatic, Terre d'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver was released in 2018 and created by Christine Nagel. The most intense note in this masculine cologne is of course vetiver, with its woody-musty facets. Citruses are the next punch of flavor, and they shine bright against the spice of the Sichuan pepper that follows, with tart bergamot to tie the fragrance together. Deep, smooth, and full, this scent is a darker yet fresher interpretation of the original scent with strength, spice, and confidence. The strength of vetiver mixed with the vitality of the Sichuan pepper and green bergamot.Vetiver, inherent to Terre since its origins, is the culmination of this new composition. The initial woody and mineral balance of Terre becomes woody and vegetal.

Fragrance Notes

Base notes- Vetiver, Olibanum, Patchouli and Amberwood.

title: Escentric Molecules M01+ Mandarin Eau De Toilette
body_html:
Escentric Molecules M01+ Mandarin Eau De Toilette

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Note:
  • Heart Note:
  • Base Note:

Description

The genius behind Escentric Molecules’ formula of perfect simplicity is in just how well they select their featured ingredients, and for the 04 series, perfumer Geza Schoen selected Javanol, a cutting-edge synthetic with sandalwood qualities. But unlike the velvety sandalwood of Molecule 01’s Iso E Super, Javanol is intriguingly crisp, with a lively, almost psychedelic freshness beneath the smooth woodiness.

Molecule 01 + Mandarin consists of Iso E Super + Mandarin. Iso E Super is an abstract synthetic molecule characterised as a cedarwood note with a warm, velvety cocooning sensation. Mandarin is a natural extracted from the mandarin orange. Geza Schoen: “Mandarin is all about the instant hit. It’s so alive, the way it radiates off the skin with that citrus zestiness. But there’s more to mandarin, it’s very fruity and aromatic as well. It’s a beautiful ingredient. Its transparency means that it vanishes quickly. I’ve touched it up with a little extra shading to extend it, adding a mandarin ingredient used in flavourings to give it super-juiciness. Then as it begins to fade, Molecule 01 syncs in, bringing a warm, erogenous feeling to play with that zinging freshness. That’s unusual – for a topnote ingredient like Mandarin and a base note like Iso E Super to dance together naked like this, without other notes coming between them. And then the mandarin is almost gone and you are left with the elevated simplicity of Molecule 01. That’s what I love about Molecule 01 + Mandarin – it may be a dance of two but the story changes completely from beginning to middle to end.”

Description

Molecule 05 consists of the molecule Cashmeran pure and singular. Cashmeran has an unusually complex character for a single molecule. It combines a cocooning, musky softness with dry, aromatic woodiness, and a sweet and resinous pine note. Cashmeran was created in a laboratory at IFF in the late 1970s.

Javanol retains the radiance and endurance of natural sandalwood, but is sheer and transparent like no sandalwood in nature. As if stripped off its heaviness, all that you then recognize in the scent are the rosy, creamy, tropical sheer wood facets in “psychedelic freshness”. It feels light, with a green “stripped bark” note that brings in an element of the great outdoors.

NAME
Oud Rosewood is a fragrance whose name alone powerfully calls to mind images and music, and stirs deep memories. Noble, powerful and moving, in a few short letters Oud Rosewood unleashes its rich scent fueled by captivating contrasts.

CHARACTER
Oud Rosewood develops an immediate presence that goes straight to the heart, as well as a moving trail of scent. This fragrance full of contrasts asserts a powerful character, a strength that is conveyed in animal notes wrapped in the milky softness of Sandalwood.

To wear Oud Rosewood is to experience a noble strength deep in your bones, wrapped in tender top notes that are as sweet as quince jam and as tangy as raspberry.

INTENSITY

title: Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de parfum Vial 2ml
body_html:
Maison Francis Kurkdjian Baccarat Rouge 540 Eau de parfum Vial 2ml

Description

In the Fall of 2014, Baccarat, the most prestigious and opulent crystalworks in the world, celebrated the 250th anniversary of their founding by releasing an extraordinary crystal decanter containing a luminous, exclusive fragrance created by Francis Kurkdjian. Only 250 of these bottles were produced, for a price of $4000 a piece. Now, for the first time ever, this spectacular fragrance is available to the world as Baccarat Rouge 540, a gorgeously woody floral-amber equal parts transparent, dense, and intense.

MFK describes Rouge 540 not in terms of top, heart and base notes, but rather as the interplay between three unique accords, each lending a distinct and visceral characteristic. The “breeze” accord, jasmine and saffron, sits sheer and delicately spiced on the skin, leading way for the cedar-driven blend of woods that make up the robust and crackling “heat” accord. Finally, a “mineral” accord of ambergris seems simultaneously warm and cool, delivering deceptively straightforward depth to mimic the sophistication of Baccarat Crystal itself. A fragrance that was only meant to belong to 250 of the world’s wealthiest collectors is now available, and we could not be more thrilled to offer it.

Fragrance Notes:

Citrus, jasmine, saffron, sage, ambergris, oakmoss, cedar

inspiration

1920. Venice was a revelation for Gabrielle Chanel. It changed her life. Shattered by the death of her lover Boy Capel, she drew strength from the bustling energy of this richly contrasted city and its mix of people and influences from around the world. There, she discovered a taste for the treasures of Byzantine and Baroque art that caught her eye and became a major source of inspiration for her style. PARIS-VENISE evokes this legendary, captivating city that marks the boundary between East and West.

The opening of saffron, lavender, and nutmeg is immediately warm and spiced: saffron's honeyed-leathery depth, lavender's cool aromatic quality, and nutmeg's warm spice establishing a sophisticated oriental character from the first spray. This balance is what makes Supremacy In Oud broadly wearable despite its bold character. The base of musk and patchouli provides a clean, lasting, earthy foundation that lets the oud speak without overwhelming. A genuinely excellent oud fragrance for those ready to embrace the king of ingredients...

  • 100% natural fragrance, Long lasting aroma in closed interiors
  • Package Contents: 1 Pack (Approx. 15 Balls of Scented Bakhoor)
  • Original Imported from U.A.E

Bukhoor or Bakhoor is the Arabic name given to scented tablets made of natural ingredients soaked in fragrant oils like oudh, amber, musk, sandalwood , rose and other essential oils. These scented tablets/chips/shavings are burned on charcoal or incense burners to perfume the house and clothing. The main purpose of bukhoor is to Perfume the house. You can use it on various occasions like wedding or creating a romantic atmosphere in your bedroom. It can also be used to welcome guests on special occasions. A lot f people use bukhoor to boost positive energy and dismiss bad sprits. Other common uses are after a meal cooking or cigarettes smoke to quickly discard the bad smells and perfume the place. Commercial shops and stores also use bukhoors to attract customers and to enhance their buying experience. Since bukhoor is not a self-lit substance as incense sticks, you will need an electrical Incense burner or a non-electric incense burner with coal to burn bukhoor. This product in display is Bakhoor in the form of small balls which can be individually put onto the incense burners. Keep away from corrosive liquids to avoid damage.

In 1986, Jacques Polge, reinterpreted his predecessor Ernest Beaux’s composition to create a fuller, more voluminous version of the now and forever women's fragrance: the Eau de Parfum. With its unprecedented use of aldehydes, which add layers of complexity, N°5 was the world’s first abstract fragrance. The Eau de Parfum draws inspiration from the Parfum with which it shares its floral aldehyde signature. This floral bouquet composed around May Rose and Jasmine features bright citrus top notes. Description

Hermes Terre D'Hermes is a luxurious, slightly spicy fragrance for men. Succumb to the power and energy brought to you by this celebration of male ego.Pamper yourself with its strong, earthy tones of cedar wood and vetiver in combination with mild spices and a fresh breath of grapefruit. You'll fall in love with Terre D'Hermes for its uniqueness and grace which provides each man with the necessary amount of wildness and elegance.Enjoy the luxury by Hermes whose perfumes are easy to define as a combination of elegant classic with a modern tinge. And Hermes Terre D'Hermes is no different. Strenghten your ego and pamper your senses. Draw pure strength and energy Terre D'Hermes obtains from natural elements and become just irresistible!The French brand Herms has a very interesting history.

The company, founded in the 1830s by Thierry Herms, originally produced horse saddles, harnesses, and other riding equipment. Later, however, he started offering other leather products (handbags, belts, etc.), roofs for convertibles, watches, silk scarves, etc. and finally luxury menswear and womens cosmetics.It is hardly surprising that many of the Herms perfumes were inspired by the aroma of leather (which also adorns some of their perfume bottles). They are fresh, sensual, bold, and sophisticated and each of them is a true work of art created just to please your senses. Not surprisingly, they have received many awards and are used by Hollywood stars: Jessica Alba, Gwyneth Paltrow, Sofia Vergara, and more. Originality, harmony, genius thats Herms!

Fragrance Notes:

Top Notes: Grapefruit, Orange

Middle Notes: Pelargonium, Pepper

Base Notes: Benzoin, Cedar, Patchouli, Vetiver

“Like a sparkling jewel box, the Roja Parfums flagship boutique at 51 Burlington Arcade nestles in one of London’s Most iconic addresses, in London’s Mayfair. Bringing the prestige and personality of this award- winning store to life, 51 Parfum is a scent where nothing is exactly as it seems. A scent created to epitomise the luxuriousness of the Roja Parfums woman, 51 portrays an exotic floral beauty that is impossible not to love. A huge note of Raspberry lends a juicy sweetness as the softness of mouth-watering Benzoin wraps around a central note of smooth Vanilla, cutting through the tartness to create a perfectly-balanced sweet centre. Spicy hints of Aniseed, Cinnamon and Clove bring a vivacious warmth that invigorates this indulgent Oriental accord, which is further livened by the brightness of eight beautiful flowers swirling around a Rose, Jasmine and Lily-forward bouquet. Luxurious wood notes of Casmir and Sandalwood sit closely to the skin, whilst a touch of powdery Orris whispers in the background. Elegant yet effervescent, 51 is a playful homage to The Burlington Arcade, where Luxury abounds, and all is not quite as it seems once you peek behind the curtain of propriety. ” – Roja Dove

title: Roja Parfums Risqué Pour Femme 100 ml
body_html:
Roja Parfums Reckless Pour Femme 100 ml

“The spirit of following your heart whilst being nobody’s fool, Reckless is the scent of the woman who is willing to take risks to get what she wants. Carefree but never careless, her sunny disposition finds her creating her own rules of enjoyment and indulgence. Opening with a trio of zesty citrus fruits, Bergamot, Mandarin and Orange introduce Reckless as a bright and energetic Floral creation with an invigorating hint of Coriander and Pink Pepper to up the excitement factor. The sweet elegance of a central Rose note is enhanced to fresher heights by Geranium, whilst the creaminess of a focal Neroli flower is given a further sensuality through an addition of Jasmine. Beneath this easy-going character, a layering of Benzoin and Vanilla enhance the natural sweetness of these petals, as the whole settles onto a bed of legendary Sandalwood – a material whose warm, creamy sweetness ties the entirety up beautifully.” – Roja Dove

title: Orto Parisi Brutus Extrait De Perfume For Unisex
body_html:
Orto Parisi Brutus Extrait De Perfume For Unisex

Description

The Nose wanted to create something that speaks of the lack of eloquence. While creating, he was inspired by the brutalism movement and a character from Italian history – Marcus Junius Brutus, Roman senator who was mainly known for his lack of expressive rhetoric. He wasn’t a conversationalist, he was precise, sharp, direct and brutal. Once decided, he did never change his mind. Brutality never engages into negotiations, neither accepts any compromises. Nature is brutal and only the fittest survive, it is the Darwinian evolutionary theory as a way of describing the mechanism of natural selection. The biological concept of fitness is defined as reproductive success. From the concept and olfactory point of view, Alessandro wanted to create something controversial. Just as the nature that can be brutal from one side, it can be perfectly balanced and beautiful from another. This is a fragrance that on the contrary to it’s name, Brutus, is very elegant, polished and subtle, it captures the link between the attraction and repulsion, between the name and the scent itself.

Fragrance Notes

Top Notes- Bergamot, Mandarin

Middle Notes- Geranium, Lavender, Rose

Base Notes- Amber, Cedar, Labdanum, Musk, Oakmoss, Patchouli

title: Tom Ford Patchouli Absolu Eau De Parfum 50ml
body_html:
Tom Ford Patchouli Absolu Eau De Parfum 50ml

Description

He iconic olfactive note of the 1970s, it evokes louche sensuality and after-dark glamour, as well as the heady blending of masculine and feminine that defined the era. This Eastern oil perfumed the skin of late 1970s glitterati and bohemians alike, pervading the air of jet-set parties with a provocative, dark glamour.
Tom Ford has reinvented this influential ingredient into a truly vanguard scent for a new era. Patchouli Absolu merges three opulent and distinctly different versions of this iconic plant ingredient. Patchouli oil contributes raw and primal texture; patchouli coeur, the ultra-luxurious, absolute extract of the plant, contributes an elusive and refined earthiness, and a breakthrough iteration of patchouli called Clearwood, used for the very first time in perfumery, is the most exquisite and pure rendition of patchouli's darkly addictive signature ever captured. The top notes are bay leaf, rosemary and moss, the heart is those patchouli notes with guiacwood, cypriol, violet wood and sheer cashmere woods, and the base is tonka bean and amber intertwined with musks and supple notes of leather.
By merging the three facets of patchouli, Tom Ford creates a uniquely unconventional heart of the fragrance. They reflect off each other to intensify the depth and intrigue we associate with patchouli.

Fragrance Notes :

  • Top notes: bay leaf, rosemary and moss
  • Heart notes: guiacwood, cypriol, violet wood, sheer cashmere woods,
  • Base notes: tonka bean ,amber intertwined musks,supple notes of leather.

Uden Overdose by Xerjoff is a Woody Spicy fragrance for women and men. Uden Overdose was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Chris Maurice. Though the name Uden Overdose implies that this scent is simply a stronger version of the original Uden, this scent has a distinct personality of its own and deserves to be taken on its own terms. How does it differ, you ask? Well, while Uden Overdose retains the wonderfully aromatic brightness of the original – the essence of its ‘fougere’ character - it swaps out the gourmand creaminess of Uden’s booze, vanilla, and lavender for the dry toastiness of spice, hay, and woody ambers. Both are utterly charming in their different ways. But if original Uden is a fougere you feel tempted to eat, Uden Overdose is a fougere you want to roll around in, like you would in piles of new mown hay.

Fragrance Notes

Top Notes- Lemon, Bergamot

Middle Notes- Ginger, Tobacco flowers, Coffee

Base Notes- Amber, Musk

Description

Pikovaya Dama 2018 by Xerjoff is a Floral Aldehyde fragrance for women Pikovaya Dama 2018 was launched in 2018. The nose behind this fragrance is Chris MauricePikovaya Dama tells the story of an iconic Russian novel written in the 19th century by Aleksandr Pushkin. Entitled The Queen of Spades, the novel plays a key role in the history of the country and serves as the inspiration for this scent. Opening with top notes of Calabrian bergamot and neroli, the heart of Pikovaya Dama Xerjoff is a powdery accord of Turkish iris, coriander and Moroccan atlas cedar. body_html: Tiziana Terenzi XIX Extrait De Parfum 100ml Description The Tiziana Terenzi collection has always taken inspiration from travel, from emotions shared around a fire and from life experience, all of which is contained in the collection. It represents that specific period in life when beauty entertains the soul and a moment becomes eternal. In the collection that they like to call “classic” because it was the first one that Tiziana created, there are two animated souls that are simultaneously contrasting and complementary. The first is a shiny, radiant gold captured in a gold bottle, and the second is a pensive, introspective black housed in a monolithic black bottle. The VOICE and the SCENT of FIRE IN SPRING EQUINOX La Focarina di S. Giuseppe on the night of 18 March – the verge of the spring equinox – it is tradition in Paolo and Tiziana’s region to build a large bonfire (“focarina”) to burn up the leftover twigs and brush from winter and make room for the rebirth of spring. The air is filled with intense smells: fresh and new, yet nevertheless ancient. Lancôme La Vie Est Belle Eau de Parfum is a symbol of freedom and happiness, a tribute to all of life’s beauty. This exclusive perfume for women was designed to put a smile on your face instantly.

The Story Of The Fragrance
La Vie Est Belle represents the choice to live life the way you want, the freedom to choose your own path to happiness and not be tied to society’s expectations. Hidden within is a balanced combination of beauty and strength. The fragrance was launched in 2012 and was created by three French perfume masters with Dominique Ropion at the helm. The Eau de Parfum bottle represents a smile in sharp crystal lines and is a reworking of the original version from 1949.

The story of Lancôme, the world-famous beauty care brand, has taken over 80 years to write. Since its inception in 1935, Lancôme products have stood out because of their proven results and boast a French magic.

Lancôme launched its first fragrance in its very first year and didn’t have to wait long for the adoration of the public. A year later, Lancôme developed its first face cream, which is still an essential part of every woman’s beauty routine thanks to its extraordinary features. Currently, Lancôme products and perfumes are some of the best-selling in their categories.

Lancôme celebrates women and helps them to gain self-confidence. Discover Lancôme cosmetics and perfume – being yourself and feeling great has never been so easy.

Fragrance Notes :

  • Top notes of bergamot, orange, pear, pink pepper & blackcurrant buds
  • Heart notes of iris pallida, tuberose, ylang-ylang, Sambac jasmine & orange blossom
  • Base note of hazelnut cream accord

A woody, chypre fragrance, the Terre D Hermes for Men was launched in 2008 and is a mix of grapefruit, orange, oak moss and benzoin notes. This vertically structured scent is very masculine, distinguished, strong, long-lasting, and attractive to those who come in contact with it. For the headstrong, non-conformist and individualistic man.

The French brand Hermès has a very interesting history. The company, founded in the 1830s by Thierry Hermès, originally produced horse saddles, harnesses, and other riding equipment. Later, however, he started offering other leather products (handbags, belts, etc.), roofs for convertibles, watches, silk scarves, etc. and finally luxury menswear and women’s cosmetics.

It is hardly surprising that many of the Hermès perfumes were inspired by the aroma of leather (which also adorns some of their perfume bottles). They are fresh, sensual, bold, and sophisticated and each of them is a true work of art created just to please your senses. Not surprisingly, they have received many awards and are used by Hollywood stars: Jessica Alba, Gwyneth Paltrow, Sofia Vergara, and more. Originality, harmony, genius – that’s Hermès!

In addition to perfumes, Hermès also produces exclusive beauty kits, containing shaving foam, shower gels, body lotions, and other products of the highest quality. So if you want to please a loved one with an extraordinary gift, do not hesitate. Hermès is sure to appeal to anyone who loves the scent of leather, is demanding, not content with something small, and who is happy to pay more for luxury.

With an opening gambit of cheerful spice provided by pink pepper and cardamom, Parisian Oud develops smartly with a top note of grapefruit, quietly tempered with subtle almond.The body opens into a medley of florals, supplied by rose essence, white jasmine and geranium, before leather and Fragrance Du Bois’ 100% pure, natural Oud builds the fragrance into a complex, sophisticated symphony. Cannabis is a green note and consequently difficult to work. It takes lots of trial and error to achieve the required balance with our pure oud oil along with other woody notes. title: Ormonde Jayne Tsarina Eau de Parfum
body_html:
Ormonde Jayne Tsarina Eau de Parfum

Fragrance Notes:

  • Top Notes: Mandarin, bergamot, coriander, cassis
  • Heart Notes: Hedione, freesia, jasmine sambac, iris, suede
  • Base Notes: Sandalwood, cedar, vanilla bean base, labdanum, musk


    DESCRIPTION

    Tsarina epitomises opulence and passion. She demands fur, leather, brocade, heavy silks in sweeping dresses and fabulous jewels to go with her haughty heritage. To call it a floral oriental is to misunderstand its rich complexity, it is more baroque. The perfume is profound, blending leather notes, rich Madagascan vanilla, amber and orris butter. This is a powerhouse perfume, ravishing and regal, distinctive and synonymous with the glamorous world of luxe. A rich and romantic smooth parfum. Tsarina is a part of the “Four Corners of the Earth” collection by Ormonde Jayne, paying homage to different parts of the world that have inspired Linda Pilkington. She has relentlessly scoured the globe, obsessed with her quest to source the world’s rarest and exotic oils for her perfume library culminating in the “Four Corners of the Earth” collection. Each perfume is an acknowledgment of the rich diversity of our extraordinary world.

title: Ormonde Jayne Nawab of Oudh
body_html:
Ormonde Jayne Nawab of Oudh

Fragrance Notes:

  • Top Notes: Green notes, Bergamot, Orange absolute, Cardamom, Aldehyde
  • Heart Notes: Rose, Magnolia, Orchid, Pimento, Bay, Cinnamon, Hedione
  • Base Notes: Ambergris, Musk, Vetiver, Labdanum, Oudh

DESCRIPTION

Agarwood trees grow aplenty in the provinces of central India. This complex but soft spicy oriental perfume is inspired by the Nawabs who once ruled over these provinces. It is a potent blend of amber and rose with a soft oudh edge. Yet, surprisingly, not one ingredient stands out from the others. It achieves a perfume synergy that defies traditional analysis, releasing a pulsating pungency, brooding and hauntingly beautiful, a rich tapestry of fascinating depths, a jewelled veil to conceal its emotional complexity and extravagance. Nawab of Oudh is a part of the “Four Corners of the Earth” collection by Ormonde Jayne, paying homage to different parts of the world that have inspired Linda Pilkington. She has relentlessly scoured the globe, obsessed with her quest to source the world’s rarest and exotic oils for her perfume library culminating in the “Four Corners of the Earth” collection. Each perfume is an acknowledgment of the rich diversity of our extraordinary world.

title: ROJA Risque Pour Femme
body_html: ROJA Risque Pour Femme Parfum FRAGRANCE NOTES Top Notes: Bergamot Heart Notes: Hyacinth, rose de Mai, jasmin de Grasse, ylang ylang, chamomile, peach Base Notes: Patchouli, oak moss, vetiver, cedar wood, labdanum DESCRIPTION Roja Dove’s thought for Risqué was a perfume that seemed tailored and disciplined – but as it develops it starts to show its overtly sensual base, which gets warmer, darker and more overt with each breath. A scent is a green floral chypre that will send shivers of pleasure down the spine of any classic chypre lover. A radiant, green-yellow bergamot pulses through the opening, bright and muscular. This is the amuse-bouche of any good chypre, that stinging slap of citric acid that presages the dark mossiness of the entrée. Stemmy green hyacinth and a dry, hay-like chamomile weave in and out of the inky oak moss, creating a tightly-woven forest floor of green, herbal, mossy hues. Further in, the dappled sunshine of the forest parts to reveal a floral heart of rose and jasmine, made faintly animalic by a lick of civet.

title: ROJA De La Nuit 3 Parfum 100ml
body_html: ROJA De La Nuit 3 Parfum 100ml FRAGRANCE NOTES Top Notes: Bergamot, Artemisia Heart Notes: Rose de Mai, Cistus Base Notes: Cardamom, Cumin, Saffron, Gurjum, Cypriol, Patchouli, Cedar wood, Guaiac wood, Juniper, Amyris, Sandalwood, Benzoin, Frankincense, Styrax, Labdanum, Leather, Ambergris DESCRIPTION With the ‘Parfums De La Nuit’ collection, Roja Dove wanted to create a range of fragrances that allow us to expose our true primal urges – which rarely surface during the day. He has always loved overtly sensual perfumes, and so created Parfums De La Nuit as a collection of three scents which allow us to reveal the inner desires lurking within us all. A set of three voluptuous fragrances with their endless list of high-end ingredients and exquisite presentation. Parfum de la Nuit 2 is a decadent a rum-soaked, fruit-infused, achingly sensual ultra-luxe pure parfum from the master of high-end indulgence. A boozy note of rum forms the heart of this creation, which is counterpointed by the freshness of citrus- zesty bergamot, tart lemon, and a juicy, gently candied orange. The cocktail is then warmed by patchouli, vetiver, and guaiac wood, all sublimated by a soft, sensual base of vanilla, cocoa and tonka. With each sniff, as with each sip, the warm comfort of intoxication takes hold more and more, until you are left in a giddy, dizzy heap.

He has always loved overtly sensual perfumes, and so created Parfums De La Nuit as a collection of three scents which allow us to reveal the inner desires lurking within us all. A set of three voluptuous fragrances with their endless list of high-end ingredients and exquisite presentation. Parfum de la Nuit 1 is a wonderfully warm, deeply woodsy ode to the passion and decadence of the evening. It opens with a subtle zing of bergamot, then quickly wraps around a majestically deep wood blend that evokes ornately paneled walls and rich, polished dark woods. Resin-infused patchouli and vetiver, earthy and savory, are given contrast and heat with a clove and saffron forward spice blend. Finally, in the compellingly long-lasting base, the true power of this pure parfum comes into the forefront, as creamy vanilla and deep labdanum mingle with balsamic notes of tolu and gently powdery tonka.

Famously reformulated in 2015 to banish a heavy, animalistic cumin note, Nüwa is now reborn as a floral oriental with a delicate transparency that jives better with its Chinese inspiration. title: ROJA Musk Aoud Crystal Parfum 100ml
body_html: ROJA Musk Aoud Crystal Parfum 100ml FRAGRANCE NOTES Top Notes: Lemon, bergamot. Heart Notes: Rose de Mai, jasmin de Grasse, ylang ylang. Base Notes: Nutmeg, patchouli, oak moss, precious wood notes, sandalwood, aoud, vanilla, tonka bean, birch, labdanum, leather, ambrette, musk. DESCRIPTION Roja Dove’s Musk Aoud is deeply, carnally suggestive. Combining two of the most legendary notes: Musk and oud, Dove has diverted the oud from its traditional route to create something completely unexpected. Mysterious and sensual, Musk Aoud oscillates between its two opposite poles – and precisely this ambivalence creates its charm and allure. Soft, skin close, intimate musk, enlightened by delicate feminine flowers meets masculine leather, distinctive woods and smoky oud, cushioned by spicy moss. But what really stands out is the current of smoky, oily sweetness running though the fragrance. The tensile weight here suggests centuries of smells packed in one on top of another, finally merging into one suggestive whole. Roja Dove’s Aoud Collection is exquisite, unique and masterfully composed – a fitting tribute to this precious essence. CARE: Roja Parfum Aouds are very dark, therefore care should be taken not to spray them on, or near, pale clothing. It is like the caress of cashmere against the skin, or a woman’s tender kiss which stays with you for a lifetime. Innuendo is full of twists and turns that take you from rose chypres to soft, musky body powders and then finally to a sweet, almost soapy tonka and sandalwood dry-down. title: ROJA Gardenia Pour Femme Parfum 50ml
body_html:
ROJA Gardenia Pour Femme Parfum 50ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes: Bergamot
  • Heart Notes: GeRose de Mai, orange blossom, jasmin de Grasse, heliotrope, mimosa, violet
  • Base Notes: Peach leaves, elemi, clove, cedar wood, sandalwood, styrax, musk



DESCRIPTION

Gardenia is one of the hardest of all scents to capture, and Roja Dove has bottled its creamy, narcotic, and sensual beauty in all its majesty. With Gardenia, Roja set out to reproduce the intoxicating aroma of real gardenias. The scent of this flower is near impossible to reproduce in perfumery due to the difficulty of extraction, but Roja’s Gardenia is therefore a clever reconstruction of the complex aroma of real gardenias using other materials. Jasmine and tuberose supply a similarly clotted-cream texture, mimosa and cedar mimic its strange, almost fungal earthiness, and peach and cloves provide that spiced, chewy fruitiness of the more tropical species of gardenia, particularly that of tiare. The opening moments of Gardenia are intensely botanical and true to life. Recommended to people who are as interested in artistry as they are in believability
