title: D.s & Durga Durga 50ml
body_html: D.s & Durga Durga 50ml Top Notes: Green Tuberose, Melon, Chrysanthemum Heart Notes: Ylang Ylang, Orris butter, Orange blossom Base Notes: Tuberose Absolute, Sambac Jasmine, fine Musc Palatial doses of the finest floral absolutes– tuberose, orris butter, orange blossom, sambac jasmine, chrysanthemum, and ylang. Unimaginably narcotic. Durga opens with eye-widening, mouthwatering freshness, the bite of green tuberose with the smooth refreshness of melon. The heart, however, is where the uncompromising abundance of luxurious florals elevates Durga above most any we’ve smelled: soft, lovely chrysanthemum, velvety sweet ylang, narcotic white florals and an unfathomably rich dose of orris deliver a stunning bouquet that has to be experienced. title: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Gift Set For Men
body_html: Paco Rabanne 1 Million Gift Set For Men Eau De Toilette 100ml + Shower Gel 100ml This set of an Eau de Toilette and a shower gel will surely be on the wish list of any fashion connoisseur. The perfume for men in this set exudes a whiff of luxury. Besides, the top notes of blood mandarine and peppermint will make you feel rejuvenated each time you decide to use it. title: Escentric Molecules Molecule 03 Eau De Toilette
body_html:
Escentric Molecules Escentric 03 Eau De Toilette

Description

The launch of the third pair of scents from Escentric Molecules takes the runaway success story of the niche fragrance world back to its roots – literally. The aroma-chemical this time is vetiveryl acetate, a refined vetiver note which is celebrated for its earthy-smoky facets.

Molecule 03 is constructed around vetiveryl acetate, a refined vetiver note, distilled from the roots of an Indian grass that is ‘crossed’ with acetic acid to remove the bitter and leathery aspects of the root. “Acetylation also brings out the grapefruit touch in vetiver,” says Geza Schoen, “giving it a more pronounced, bitter-fresh top note.”

Molecule 03 opens with a heady, sparkling brightness that transitions into a rooty earthiness. The hallmark, slightly sweet and very green heart of this perennial grass rises to the surface of your skin in compliment. An ultimate yin and yang of cold and hot – a skin scent with a sly sillage.

body_html: Nobile 1942 1001 Eau de Parfum 75ml FRAGRANCE NOTES Top Notes : Bergamot, Red tea, Ginger, Elemi, Pink Pepper Heart Notes : Papyrus, Turkish rose essence, Jasmin absolute, iris, saffron curcuma absolute Base Notes : Patchouli, Sandalwood, Amber, Vanilla, Musk Fragrance Family : Oriental, Woody, Floral DESCRIPTION Reading is like magic. An emotion that has neither time nor place, immortalised in a word on the page and therefore ready to be enjoyed anywhere, anytime. “The idea of 1001", the new fragrance from NOBILE 1942, says Stefania Giannino, Artistic Director for this Genovese brand, “is precisely this sense of continuity, of waiting, of seduction by words. Nobody gives a better idea of the power of seductive story-telling than Scheherazade, the heroine in Arabian Nights, who managed to enchant the man who wanted to kill her with her 1001 tales. It was this very book, which I adore and which I discovered in the original language during my studies of Arabic at L’Orientale university, that gave me the input for 1001." The main player in this fragrance is Papyrus, the writing medium par excellence, since the dawn of civilisation and through to relatively recent times. The fragrance opens on a lively, bright note, with the fresh spices of elemi, fresh ginger and pink pepper interwoven with the juiciness of Red tea, reflecting the optimism and patience of this woman who tells wond...

title: Nobile 1942 Rudis Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html: Nobile 1942 Rudis Eau de Parfum 75ml FRAGRANCE NOTES Top Notes : Bergamot, Dried fruits, Fruity notes, wine Heart Notes : Rose, Geranium, Cloves, Saffron, Cedarwood Base Notes : Leather, Patchouli, Vetiver, Incense, Musk, Helicrysium Fragrance Family : Woody, Spicy DESCRIPTION Rudis is the first part of a paradigm shift in the history of Nobile 1942 - a new direction, towards strong, intense and opulent scents. The first fragrance of the Premium collection is dedicated to a special characteristic: strength. In ancient Rome, "Rudis" was the wooden sword that was used by gladiators during their training, and worn into the battle arena as a symbol of their strength and valour and freedom. The sword was a gift that a gladiator got, when he got rid of his status as a slave - as a reward for the bravery he had shown during the battles. The scent, Rudis, a full portrait of one such ancient warrior, garbed in hardened leather armor, his sword adorned with flowers for courage and luck, fortified with wine and spirits for the battle that awaits. It is a demonstration of the values of strength and gentleness, of struggle and freedom, of life and death, of masculinity and weakness in its conflict. Rudis opens with an opulent blend of whiskey and leather, infused with tart fruits, smoky wood, buttery saffron, and the golden sweetness of immortelle. The leather’s luxuriousness has a sensual...

title: Nobile 1942 Il Sentiero Degli Dei Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html: Nobile 1942 Il Sentiero Degli Dei Eau de Parfum 75ml FRAGRANCE NOTES Top Notes : Lemon, Green leaves, fruity notes Heart Notes : Jasmine, Rose, Iris, Orange flower Base Notes : Woody accord, Amber, Musk, Tonka bean Fragrance Family : Citrus, Floral, Woody DESCRIPTION Il Sentiero Degli Dei or "The Path of the Gods" takes its name, and inspiration from a rather beautiful and famous hiking trail that stretches between Bomerano and Nacelle, two tiny villages perched on the cliffsides on the Sorrento coastline, overlooking the endless blue of the Mediterranean sea. This incredible route, where the ridges of Lattari’s Mountains slide and sink into the blue of the sea toward the Island of Capri, still tells its myths and legends to people who live there and to walkers. The name of this trail is derived from Greek mythology and the story of the encounter between Greek hero Ulysses and the Sirens. As the story goes, Ulysses had his men strap him to the mast of the ship while his crew muffled their ears so they would not hear the fateful song of the Sirens. The Gods of Olympus, flew down to Earth to prevent their favorite from becoming shipwreck. But they landed a good way to the east and, in their haste to save Ulysses, stampeded along what was then a pristine and gentle coastline, leaving in their wake the cliffs and beautiful landscape we now call the Amalfi Coast. Legends aside, ther...

title: Nobile 1942 MALUS Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
Nobile 1942 MALUS Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Apple, Frankincense, Pink Pepper
  • Heart Notes : Incense, Cedar, Myrrh, Amber
  • Base Notes : Guaiac wood, Vetiver, Musk, Vanilla, Sandalwood
  • Fragrance Family : Woody, Incense, Spicy


DESCRIPTION

Malus (or, as the ancient Romans used to write, "Malvs") - the bad, the evil - is the unusual theme of this extraordinary perfume. Behind the illusion of knowing, what we write or read mirrors what we want to be and not what we really are. In one form or another it is in each of us, well hidden as a well-kept secret in the abysses of the soul, in hidden corners of our heart. Many of these hidden truths are sleeping there for a lifetime - but in some cases they will break out.

This spicy oriental scent represents the mask that shields others from uncovering all of one's secrets. As your phantom darkness tangos with your inner light, this fragrance becomes your invisible cloak.

Malus is unleashed by a frankincense-soaked top note of spicy pink pepper, and the apple - the eternal symbol of the forbidden fruit and seduction par excellence.
Meanwhile, in the heart of the perfume, a storm of smoky notes, cedar wood, amber and myrrh rages - followed by a dry-down of guaiac and sandalwood, musk, vanilla and vetiver.

title: Nobile 1942 Perdizione Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
Nobile 1942 Perdizione Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Bergamot, Grapefruit
  • Heart Notes : Neroli, Orange Blossom, Ylang Ylang, Jasmine
  • Base Notes : Cedarwood, Vanilla, Musk
  • Fragrance Family : Citrus, Floral


DESCRIPTION

It is immensely liberating to completely let yourself go, to give in utterly to pleasure and let the tides of delight carry you where they will. With Perdizione, Nobile 1942 created exactly that - a lusciously rich tempest of sweet florals whipped up in a compellingly smooth, creamy layer of musks and woods to transport you to a summer night, far, far away...

A cool and soft breeze, perhaps a portent of the coming storm, carries the scent of Bergamot and Grapefruits. It takes one back to pleasant, untroubled times of our lives. Bright and sensual Neroli and Orange blossoms fill the air with a bright and sensual fragrance, made warm by an intoxicating note of Ylang-ylang and elegant, feminine Jasmine. perfectly blends with the Musk. The heart jumps at the memory of that beautiful, radiant, fleeting figure. Clean, pure Cedarwood, along with Musk and creamy and reassuring Vanilla envelope everything in a blissful haze to take you on a walk down the beach, a quest for a long lost peace of mind.

title: Nobile 1942 La Danza delle Libellule Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
Nobile 1942 La Danza delle Libellule Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Apple, Bergamot
  • Heart Notes : Cinnamon, Cocoa
  • Base Notes : Cedarwood, Vanilla, Musk
  • Fragrance Family : Gourmand


DESCRIPTION

Unapologetically luxurious and joyously self-assured, La Danza delle Libellule The Dance of the Dragonflies) is a fragrance to devote to yourself, when femininity cries out, claiming some time for frivolousness, cuddles and the gentle insouciance that all women deserve. Inspired from all the romatic elements that make up Franz Lehar's composition the “Dance of the Dragonflies”, an operetta that met with great success, the scent brings all the lightness necessary to soothe even the most troubled hearts.

Like the delicately beautiful insects that inspired Lehar in the first place, La Danza delle Libellule delights with its playful grace. Opening with an intensely juicy burst of apple and bergamot, La Danza immediately distinguishes itself from more straightforward gourmands with its understated approach to sweetness: dry cedar and rich cinnamon give contrast to the bright fruitiness without ever getting sugary or cloying. A pure vanilla, supported with cocoa and musk, comforts and pampers in a heart-warming sugary cloud.

A bold, beautiful, and unapologetically feminine scent that's sure to conjure up fantasies of majestic castles and storybook romance to charm even the most jaded fragrance fan.

title: Nobile 1942 Patchouli Nobile Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
Nobile 1942 Patchouli Nobile Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Lemon, White Pepper, Fresh notes, Incense
  • Heart Notes : Jasmine, Patchouli, Gaiac wood, Cistus
  • Base Notes : Ambery notes, Labdanum, Tonka bean, Sandalwood, Patchouli, Oak Moss
  • Fragrance Family : Chypre, Woody

DESCRIPTION

Earthy and rich and hypnotic and evocative - the scent of patchouli is ever so distinctive. Patchouli Nobile pays homage to this deep, highly recognizable note.

The scent seduces without resorting to brute force. The scent has a caressing amber-tinged sweetness that nestles into the loamy richness of clean earth and smooth wood and it retains the dry freshness of its opening of incense and pepper. It is both elegantly refined and devastatingly sexy. The patchouli is absolutely present, but it's not overpowering, thanks to the lowery heart of jasmine. The layers of sandalwood, oak moss, amber and tonka add a luxurious, velvety quality that makes this superbly wearable.
It is a fragrance which embodies the desire for renewal, change and revolution, like no other fragrance can. Patchouli Nobile stands for creativity, openness, and the strength to find new ways.

If you are already a fan of patchouli, this is a must-try, while new-comers will find themselves becoming converts to the patchouli cult as well!

title: Nobile 1942 Ambra Nobile Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
Nobile 1942 Ambra Nobile Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Bergamot, Neroli, Amber
  • Heart Notes : Helichrysum, Labdanum, Pacthouli
  • Base Notes : Tonka Bean, Cedarwood, Sandalwood, Vetiver from Haiti
  • Fragrance Family : Ambery, Woody


DESCRIPTION

A modern yet bohemian amber scent, impeccably done. Warm, powdery and soothing.
Amber is a symbol of irresistible and eternal, carnal and spiritual love without inihibitions. Its fragrance is sensual and animalic yet delicate at the same time. The warm perfume intoxicates senses with its sweet, elegant notes of leather and the sea.

Ambra Nobile evokes “nights for happy lovers - bright and brief". The aphrodisiac perfume of amber burns up with a fresh citrus and orange blossom opening leading into an inebriated, resinous heart of liquery Helichrysum, laudanum and patchouli.
There is a startling hint of salt and stone in the transition, quickly moving past that into a smooth and comforting blend of tonka bean, Haitian vetiver, cedar and sandalwood as the calm after the olfactory storm. Pure elegance!

title: Nobile 1942 Sandalo Nobile Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
Nobile 1942 Sandalo Nobile Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Saffron, Cumin
  • Heart Notes : Iris, Fig, Gurjan Balsam
  • Base Notes : Siam Benzoin, White Sandalwood, Cedarwood
  • Fragrance Family : Woody, Spicy


DESCRIPTION

Breathe in and out. Let your muscles rest and put your mind at ease with a concoction of saffron, cumin and the star of this composition- the sandalwood. Sandalo Nobile makes us one with Mother Nature and empowers us to face a new day with serenity.
Spicy yet smooth, robustly textured yet soft-spoken, Sandalo Nobile is a deliciously woodsy treat for the senses. It is a just-stronger-than-skin scent that even the manliest of men could wear with confidence.

The scent opens with a rich tapestry of spices, where fiery cumin and mouthwatering saffron open the palate to a buttery iris that seals in the near-gourmand elements just in time for the woods to emerge. And what a blend of woods it is- lightly green fig tree, peppery gurjum, fresh cedar, and the star of the show, a sandalwood both creamy and robust, velvety smooth, and humming with quiet power. It is an everyday sandalwood scent that doesn't believe that discretion is the opposite of personality!

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Heart Notes : Geranium, Orange Blossom, Myrrh
  • Base Notes : Labdanum, Tonka Bean, Patchouli, Leather, Sandalwood
  • Fragrance Family : Citrus, Woody

DESCRIPTION

Acqua Nobile is a lively and sparkling composition from Nobile 1942. Part of the 'I Rigati' series, the scent exudes a subtle strength and refinement, an elixir of natural aromas both harmonious and pure in character.

Water, a symbol of life, strength, wisdom and power is eternalized in a perfume which offers constant changes and a flow of harmonious accords.

A citrusy fusion of Italian bergamot and Sicilian mandarin with neroli and cardamom create refreshing top notes. The heart is a floral harmony of geranium, myrrh and orange blossom, while the base is created from woody accords with accentuated balminess and includes labdanum, tonka, patchouli, leather and sandalwood.

title: The House of Oud The Time Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
The House of Oud The Time Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Bergamot, Wormwood, Blue Camomile
  • Heart Notes : Blue Tea, Iris, Verbena
  • Base Notes : Cedarwood, Musks, Amber, Black Tea
  • Fragrance Family : Floral


DESCRIPTION

THE TIME is a moment, a fleeting instant of presence, of awareness within ourselves. It is the lucid consciousness of living ourselves and of intensely experiencing a moment that we share with the most authentic, profound part of ourselves. To which we offer care and respect, in a ritual rich with gratitude, like the Japanese tea preparation ceremony.

THE TIME sets its inner clock to 5 in the afternoon and that’s where it slows down: silence spins the minutes out and instils a sense of security. Time tightens its grip and allows us the luxury of observing how things flow, in a profound understanding of events both within us and without.
THE TIME is time for ourselves. Time that lasts an instant, a day or a whole lifetime.

This composition is an invitation to practise introspection: the prelude is Bergamot in an accord with Camomile and the calm of Wormwood, whose warm, woody note shields and reassures. Blue Tea, Iris and Verbena are the throbs of a heart that does not mark the passing of time, but expands it to infinity, wrapping us in a dimension of care and respect. With the expressive force of Cedarwood, Musks and Amber, the base receives the precious, dynamising notes of Black Tea.

title: The House of Oud Live in Colors Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
The House of Oud Live in Colors Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Lemon, Grapefruit, Red Fruits
  • Heart Notes : Ginger, Pink Pepper
  • Base Notes : Musks, Hinoki, Amber
  • Fragrance Family : Sparkling Woody


DESCRIPTION

LIVE IN COLOURS is that moment when the present takes the plunge into the future. It is a clear bridge across time, where creativity breaks down the inner barriers that were incapable of giving it a shape or a sound, and explodes free and joyful, using the voice of colours to tell its story.

Like a brush on a canvas, this perfume permeates the skin. In LIVE IN COLOURS, nuances are illuminated, play with the light and reflect states of the soul. As weightless as the air, they chase after the forms of nature, embracing energies and becoming ideas free of all judgement. These colours set all their verve free, unselfconscious and, ultimately, oblivious to the fact that they are masterpieces.

LIVE IN COLOURS is the joy of creative freedom. Of thought. Of emotion. Of being.

Full of fun, explosive and contagious: this fragrance opens with a declaration of intent from Lemon, Grapefruit and Red Fruits that play and chase each other until they reach the heart. Here, the stimulating sensations of Ginger and Pink Pepper tease your sense of smell and invite your emotions to float to the surface. The finale is worth remembering: notes of amber and musk set the scene for Hinoki, the surprising Japanese wood whose aroma is dry, fresh and sometimes mystical, chosen here to represent a miracle: the moment when a creative verve first sees the light of day.

title: The House of Oud Just Before Eau de Parfum 75ml
body_html:
The House of Oud Just Before Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Bergamot, Lemon, Saffron
  • Heart Notes : Palo Santo, Ylang-Ylang, Myrrh
  • Base Notes : Vanilla, Benzoin, Amber, Sandalwood
  • Fragrance Family : Gourmand


DESCRIPTION

JUST BEFORE is the gathering mist of expectation. It stretches out in yearning and aspires. A projection of unfettered imagination that acquires body and becomes passion, it contains the quiver of excitement, desire that’s shaped by imagination as one thought chases another.

JUST BEFORE captures the instant before a kiss, the skin you caress, your breath that mingles. It is that moment when we are enveloped in creative energy, when endless possibilities come together in a single arrow aimed at the bullseye. And before that moment strikes, it duplicates our heartbeats, dissolves our thoughts and mixes our emotions.

JUST BEFORE is the urge to achieve the desires we strain to reach every time, but never quite arrive at completely.

The bouquet announces its arrival with the freshness of Bergamot, in accord with the juicy expressiveness of Lemon and the pungent character of Saffron. This is how ideas are concentrated together, the beginning of expectation. With a sensual, embracing heart, thought is translated into action: Myrrh now starts its dance with Ylang-Ylang against the backdrop of Palo Santo, the essence used by Inca shamans in their religious rituals. The base, heart-rending and of incalculable depth, has the sweetness of Vanilla and the passion of Sandalwood, a reminder that the true pleasure of expectation is ultimately in the anticipation.

body_html:
The House of Oud Wonderly Eau de Parfum 75ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Goji berry, Apricot
  • Heart Notes : African neroli, Almond flower, Sambac jasmine
  • Base Notes : Virginia cedarwood, concrete Italian iris, Mysore sandalwood,Myrrh from Sinai, Cosmone, Madagascar vanilla, Yemeni incense
  • Fragrance Family : Oriental, Woody


DESCRIPTION

WONDERLY is a point of view. It is everything exceptional that is narrated by the desert as the snow falls to the ground. Your eyes open wide. You catch your breath. Gravity seems to be suspended, while amazement, rapture and wonder spread out in reaction to an event so rare and to the awareness that even just being allowed to experience it is a great gift. Just as in a unique, unexpected and completely unpredictable moment, magic takes shape in front of your very eyes, overwhelming you with its rare beauty.
Nothing is impossible. The unexpected can happen.

WIND HEAT is the perfume that welcomes the full day. It is a handshake, a vibrant bouquet that encapsulates the vital energy, élan and optimism unleashed by those who infect everyone they meet with their warmth as soon as they leave the house in the morning. An authentic anthem to the liveliness of the wind.
WIND HEAT is a handshake, a vibrant bouquet, an anthem to the liveliness of the wind.

GOLDEN POWDER is the embrace of those who venture out across the desert. A fever of optimist.

EMPATHY is a reset: it is a chance to settle down and listen to another’s soul, making a gift of our emotive attention.
EMPATHY is the storytelling of an instant. Our bubble of perfection.

A surprising watercolour tones down the forces of the most luxuriant nature with the delicacy of infinity, gilded and shining bright. The time of confidences passes by in nature’s embrace, walking slowly in the shade of a row of green cypresses.

CYPRESS SHADE is the refuge of an eternal bond.

This is a beginning that blossoms as a sign of originality, in the garden of opportunities.

ALMOND HARMONY is the unexpected that comes to live.

title: FRAGRANCE DU BOIS London Oud Eau de Parfum 15ml
body_html:
FRAGRANCE DU BOIS London Oud Eau de Parfum 15ml


FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Lemon, Bergamot, Spearmint
  • Heart Notes : Lavender, Jasmine, White Flowers, Marine Notes
  • Base Notes : Patchouli, Cedar Wood, Nutmeg, Cardamom, 100% pure organic vintage Oud

  • Fragrance Family : Woody, Aromtic, Green


DESCRIPTION

The fragrance opens like a fresh spring morning in London, with the mist rolling off the Thames and swirling across parks and around the ankles of early morning joggers. As the morning progresses, so too does the fragrance.

Faint nuances of citrus and lavender give way to complex white floral notes, matching the vibrant character of the city.

The fragrance bustles through busy florals and exciting spices, perfectly reflecting cosmopolitan London. The day and the city drift through a warm afternoon into a balmy evening. Subtle and rich woods enhance this warm feel, with daring Oud preparing the senses for an exciting night of partying in the world's greatest city.

DESCRIPTION

Roja Dove’s tribute to Qatar focuses on ambergris, one of the rarest materials on earth, and presents it in all its luxurious richness.

The fragrance opens with sumptuous waves of sweet, salty, musky, caramel ambergris infused with toffee’d labdanum, praline-scented benzoin, and creamy vanilla. As if to mimic Qatar’s famous islands, Roja Dove then dots the golden ambered waters with a complex mix of the gourmand and the oriental: roses drenched in sweet peach, jammy patchouli, fiery saffron, delectable candy floss, plush orris, and an exhibition of soft, creamy woods. They take turns dancing and weaving around the opulent golden core, a feast for the senses that invites you to indulge in the perfume world’s most sumptuous treasure with all the extravagant excess for which Roja Dove is renowned.

title: ROJA Sultanate Of Oman Parfum 50ml
body_html:
ROJA Sultanate Of Oman Parfum 50ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Grapefruit, Orange
  • Heart Notes : Rose de Mai, Jasmin de Grasse, Violet, Raspberry
  • Base Notes : Cardamom, Elemi, Saffron, Gurjum, Papyrus, Oak moss, Cedar wood, Guaiacwood, Amyris, Sandalwood, Aoud, Carrot Seed, Orris, Frankincense, Birch, Musk

  • Fragrance Family : Oriental


DESCRIPTION

The Sultanate of Oman is Roja Dove’s ode to the best frankincense in the world, which is harvested in Salalah, a sub-tropical region at the foot of the Dhofar Mountains in Oman.

Rare and prestigious, Omani frankincense is regarded as a gift from God and produces such a fine aroma that it is usually reserved for use by the royal families of the Sultanates.

Sultanate of Oman pairs this special frankincense with a dry oud, leather, woods, and other ancient resins to produce an aroma that is as hauntingly exotic. Overall a dry, resinous fragrance, there are little olfactory surprises that elevate this extrait de parfum; a dash of saffron for astringency, birch for a lapsang souchong smokiness, and jasmine, raspberry, and violets for a creamy swirl of sweetness. Austere and opulent in equal measure, the Sultanate of Oman is a magnificent showcase for Omani silver frankincense, and truly a fragrance fit for royalty.

  • Base Notes : Pink Pepper, Cumin, Cypriol, Patchouli, Oak moss, Guaiacwood, Aoud, Benzoin, Frankincense, Labdanum, Musk

  • Fragrance Family : Oriental


DESCRIPTION

United Arab Emirates is Roja Dove’s love letter to the people of the Middle East who joyfully douse themselves in the most luxurious of fragrances. Inspired by men unafraid to wear the richest and creamiest of rose fragrances, and women who proudly wore the most animalic of ouds.

This extrait de parfum pays tribute to this taste for exuberance and luxury by loading up on the most sumptuous raw materials in the world – the costliest Ta’if rose, the smokiest, most refined Laotian oud, and the finest floral absolutes and concentrates available this side of Grasse. Supported by a creamy mélange of white and yellow flowers such as jasmine, gardenia, and ylang, a bright, pure Ta’if rose sings out.

The leathery, animalic oud note is sharpened by an undercurrent of civet, but buried deep enough in a cloud of benzoin and spices to soften its impact. The roses, white flowers, and creamy civet come together over a dense, smoky layer of resins, woods, and oud, creating a shimmering, sensual halo of a scent.

DESCRIPTION

Reckless is a fragrance made for a woman whom Roja Dove imagines follows her heart to get what she wants, often taking risks to get it even if that makes her seem reckless, but never foolish. He imagines her in the half-light, wearing a diamond necklace, and the fragrance itself reflects this sense of uncompromising luxury.

Opening on a diamond-bright spray of aldehydes and delicious citrus, Reckless shimmers hard against a dark blue velvet backdrop of jasmine, violet, cinnamon, and ylang ylang. In the heart, a touch of spice appears, with pink pepper, cinnamon and cool rose. Reckless slowly sheds her mantle of velvety flowers to reveal a leathery, animalic finish of sandalwood, vanilla and sensual musk that will titillate and intrigue. This girl is not vulgar. But underneath her civility beats an untamed tiger heart.

title: ROJA Enigma Pour Femme Parfum 50ml
body_html:
ROJA Enigma Pour Femme Parfum 50ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Bergamot
  • Heart Notes : Geranium, rose de Mai, neroli, jasmin de Grasse, ylang ylang, heliotrope, peach
  • Base Notes : Patchouli, sandalwood, vanilla, orris, ambergris, musk

  • Fragrance Family : Oriental


DESCRIPTION

The aura of the name Enigma made Roja Dove create a fragrance that appears to be something different for everyone, but in itself is very determined and sure, though it causes this sense of ambiguity in others. A noble and sensual skin fragrance, delicate and alluring.

Enigma should be mysterious and irresistible and Roja Dove has certainly kept his word: characterized by ambivalence, Enigma inimitably oscillates between its poles. Cool and equally warm, fruity and fresh, but still powdery and skin-close with a subtle sweetness that is difficult to describe.

The fragrance is illuminated with a tart citric brightness, while the heart cozy’s up with florals that cling to the skin with their creamy, powdery and fragrantly glowing nuances. Vanilla and musk are wrapped in gentle softness, kissed by peach and gently powdered by iris. Ambergris, sandalwood and patchouli bring a noble bearing and round the composition warmly off.

ROJA Danger Pour Femme Parfum 50ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Lemon, bergamot, grapefruit, mandarin
  • Heart Notes : Rose de Mai, gardenia, jasmin de Grasse, ylang ylang, violet, peach
  • Base Notes : Clove, patchouli, sandalwood, vanilla, tonka bean, orris, musk

  • Fragrance Family : Oriental


DESCRIPTION

.Full of potent aphrodisiacs, this fragrance is not dangerous for the woman who wears it, but for the man who smells it on her. Roja Dove has warned us – and rightly so: Danger transforms every woman into a modern siren – if she so wishes. A soft, powdery scent with touches of fresh fruit and flowers.

The fruity tartness is perfectly balanced out by the creaminess of tropical flowers. Juicy tangerine, sparkling grapefruit, tart-fruity bergamot and sparkling lemon create a youthful freshness that is wedded to a voluptuous heart: Opulent flowers and velvety peach know how to charm - lush jasmine, powdery-creamy violet, ylang-ylang of a honey-sweet temperament and fruity rose form an enchanting bouquet. The base creates warmth along with gourmand notes: vanilla milk, spicy-warm sandalwood, a sweet and spicy clove, iris powder, cotton-soft musk and delicious Tonka bean earthed by patchouli. This sweet, nutty creaminess blends into the wearer’s skin, appearing downright edible.

body_html:

  • Heart Notes : Lily of the valley, rose de Mai, gardenia, orange blossom, jasmin de Grasse, tuberose, lily, ylang ylang, raspberry
  • Base Notes : Violet leaves, aniseed, cinnamon, clove, patchouli, casmir wood, sandalwood, benzoin, vanilla, orris

  • Fragrance Family : Oriental


DESCRIPTION

51 was inspired by the idea of nothing being quite what it seems, which is the whole story of Roja Parfums’ flagship store at 51, Burlington Arcade. It is in one way the epitome of propriety, soberness and refinement, yet underneath it lies a backstory that is all but that.

A homage to timeless femininity. Inspired by the best of the past, created today to be worn tomorrow.

A rich and sensual floral bouquet of lily of the valley, rose, gardenia, orange blossom, jasmine, tuberose, lily, and ylang ylang is given an unusual twist with a touch of raspberry. An infusion of citrus and violet leaves and a spicy heart of aniseed, cinnamon, and clove enlivens the scent. Nestling on a warm, soft base of cashmere and sandal wood, patchouli, benzoin, vanilla, and powdery orris, 51 promises the wearer and bystander a whiff of the eternal British icon.

body_html: ROJA Vetiver Pour Homme Eau de Parfum 100ml FRAGRANCE NOTES Top Notes : Lemon, Bergamot, Litsea Cubeba Heart Notes : Rose de Mai, Jasmin de Grasse, Cistus Base Notes : Galbanum, Celery Seed, Pink Pepper, Caraway, Nutmeg, Pepper, Oakmoss, Vetiver, Cedarwood, Cedar Needles, Guaiacwood, Amyris, Labdanum Fragrance Family : Chypre DESCRIPTION Quite simply one of the best examples of vetiver in modern perfumery, Roja Dove’s Vetiver is a green forest bottled. With a pure focus on vetiver, this is the kind of scent that will satisfy hardcore vetiver aficionados but also win over the those reluctant of this ingredient purely on the merit of incredible raw materials and blending. Roja's Vetiver possesses none of the synthetic woodiness that can sometimes make vetiver-dominant fragrances too fuzzy in feel, nor does it allow vetiver’s natural tendencies towards sour marshiness to emerge. The grassy, nutty, and oily properties of vetiver root are all present and correct, but are pushed to the background where they perform as a creamy, woody hum to allow the tart yet lush citrusy facets of the root to shine. Vetiver is a series of little balancing acts between smoke & wood, damp & dry, and green & creamy, that add up to a symphonic whole where nothing sticks out. title: ROJA Fetish Pour Homme Parfum 50ml
body_html:
ROJA Fetish Pour Homme Parfum 50ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Lemon, bergamot, lime
  • Heart Notes : Neroli, Jasmin de Grasse, Violet, Fig
  • Base Notes : Cardamom, elemi, pink pepper, cinnamon, pepper, oak moss, vetiver, patchouli, benzoin, vanilla, labdanum, leather, ambergris, musk


DESCRIPTION

An incredibly rich, raw, and direct leather fragrance, Fetish projects an image of male sexuality so potent that it casts a spell and never lets go.

Leather can be so compulsive that for many it becomes a type of fetish. Roja Dove thought of leather in a man’s world. He thought of the soft sensuality of it against the skin, and the timeless appeal of a successful, masculine man and the things he surrounds himself with.

Powerful, striking leather wrapped in elegant smoke. Fetish opens on a sharp lime note, then commences on a slow build to a spicy, pungent leather perched on top of a pile of smoking resins, patchouli, and bitter oak moss. Confident, peppery warmth, flirty, sweet-spicy cinnamon, silky oak moss, creamy jasmine and powdery, earthy violets offer a congenial wealth of repeating contrasts. Hesperides provide dynamic freshness in the top notes.

This feral, hyper-macho leather accord eventually comes to rest on a tangy resinous warmth, seductively sweetened by creamy vanilla that is boozy yet satisfying.

Fetish Pour Homme flatters a man who knows exactly what he wants - and always gets.

title: ROJA Enigma Pour Homme Parfum Cologne 100ml
body_html:
ROJA Enigma Pour Homme Parfum Cologne 100ml

FRAGRANCE NOTES

  • Top Notes : Bergamot
  • Heart Notes : Geranium, Rose de Mai, Neroli, Jasmin de Grasse, Heliotrope
  • Base Notes : Cardamom, Ginger, Pepper, Patchouli, Cognac, Tobacco, Sandalwood, Benzoin, Vanilla, Ambergris


DESCRIPTION

The mystery of the name Enigma drove Roja Dove to create a fragrance that seems to be all things to all people, but itself is certain and assured, whilst creating ambiguity in others.

Enigma is mysterious and irresistible. Characterized by ambivalence, Enigma inimitably oscillates between its poles. Cool and equally warm, fruity and fresh, but still powdery and skin-close with a subtle sweetness that is difficult to describe.

A tart citric brightness illuminates the fragrance, while the heart cozy’s up with a bouquet of gorgeous flowers like rose, geranium, neroli and jasmine which provide on the one hand freshness, on the other hand creaminess. A vanilla-almondy impression from heliotrope is deliciously accentuated by the warmth of the base.
This is a masterpiece in itself: warm, soft and liqueur-like wonderfully spiced and sweetened by resins. Tobacco leaves set accents, as well as tart, fruity ginger along with pepper and cardamom. Patchouli lends Enigma more body and depth, while the precious woods perfectly round off the creation.

A striking and sensual fragrance created for men.

body_html:
ROJA Danger Pour Homme Parfum Cologne-100ml

DESCRIPTION

Ridiculously masculine and full of potent aphrodisiacs – Danger Pour Homme is not dangerous for the man who wears it, but for the woman who smells its smoky, woodsy, aromatic heart, and the gruff, animalic leather base on him.
Between delicious herbs and majestic lavender, creamy-sweet lush jasmine, powdery, earthy violet and the clean freshness of lily of the valley, surprisingly distinctive leather notes and animalistic nuances can be found.
After a classically barbershop opening – sparkling citrus notes tickle the nose at first, feigning innocence – Danger settles into a warm, salty ambergris accord, as mineralic and as sweet as a fresh sea breeze, yet rich and ambery - a dangerous liaison in the making. The musky, slightly grimy leather that develops in the base is a textured thing of great beauty, completing this captivating and highly addictive rich, leather fougere.
In this case, “Forewarned is forearmed” is a useless cliché because everyone will do their utmost to expose themselves to this kind of Danger!

Cologne by Thierry Mugler was first manufactured in 2001. It is in the family of the fresh citrus fragrances.

Inspired by the clean fresh scent of a soap from Mugler's childhood, Cologne was designed to appeal to people who don't really like fragrance! Cologne draws on the tradition of early colognes, it is fresh and citrus-sy and is the olfactory opposite of the distinctive scent of Angel.

Thierry Mugler (born 1948 in Strasbourg, France) opened a salon of the same name in 1973 in the fashion capital of Paris. In the 1970s, he mainly focused on French customers and specialised in clever ideas that went against momentary trends. He only had a go at his first perfume in 1992.

Thierry Mugler sees himself more as a conductor who adds a concrete form to what he can see around him on a daily basis. Of course, he is quite a successful ‘conductor’ in both fashion and accessories, and also the Thierry Mugler brand perfumes. He is currently gaining ground with Thierry Mugler Alien or the timeless, ageless Thierry Mugler Angel. As a costume designer, Thierry Mugler is responsible for many of Beyoncé’s outfits, and was also involved in the making of the film “Perfume: The Story of a Murderer”.

An immortal symbol of elegance, perfection and luxury. Dior, one of the most exclusive French fashion brands, was founded in 1946 by the famous Christian Dior. Today Dior has not only haute-couture fashion lines, but also luxury leather goods, accessories, shoes, jewellery, watches, fragrance and beauty products in their portfolio.

Christian Dior was born at the very beginning of the 20th Century in a family of a fertiliser manufacturer. Before he became one of the most influential fashion designers in the world, Dior studied international affairs and diplomacy and later ran a small art gallery. Immediately after the war, he opened his own fashion house in Paris, became famous by creating what amounted to a revolution in womens fashion (the legendary New Look), and progressively spread his empire over more than fifteen countries. His brand is still a synonym of everything elegant, feminine and beautiful, even though Christian Dior himself has died more than sixty years ago.

Dior entered the world of perfumery in 1947 with Miss Dior, named in honour of Christians sister Catherine. The cypress-floral composition quickly became popular and revolutionised the whole perfume business. To this day, the brand has launched over 150 fragrances designed by many world-renowned perfumers.

Bukhoor or Bakhoor is the Arabic name given to scented tablets made of natural ingredients soaked in fragrant oils like oudh, amber, musk, sandalwood , rose and other essential oils. These scented tablets/chips/shavings are burned on charcoal or incense burners to perfume the house and clothing. The main purpose of bukhoor is to Perfume the house. You can use it on various occasions like wedding or creating a romantic atmosphere in your bedroom. It can also be used to welcome guests on special occasions. A lot f people use bukhoor to boost positive energy and dismiss bad sprits. Other common uses are after a meal cooking or cigarettes smoke to quickly discard the bad smells and perfume the place. Commercial shops and stores also use bukhoors to attract customers and to enhance their buying experience. Since bukhoor is not a self-lit substance as incense sticks, you will need an electrical Incense burner or a non-electric incense burner with coal to burn bukhoor. This product in display is Bakhoor in the form of small balls which can be individually put onto the incense burners. Keep away from corrosive liquids to avoid damage.

With Versace Red Jeans, turn back the clock to a simpler time and channel your bohemian spirit. Sweet and sensuous, this electrifying Eau De Toilette, shows off the whimsical side of the first house of fashion - Versace.
Fuzzy soft notes of apricot mixed with peppery fresh freesia and sweet hints of peach make up a temptingly light top note. This is followed by an enticing heart note with clean and bright extracts of lily of the valley, sweet hints of rose, subtle notes of water lily, floral notes of ylang-ylang and powdery violet. Finishing off with a base note of rich sandalwood, hints of soothing musk and the creamy essence of vanilla, this fragrance leaves you with a desire for more. With fruity and floral notes balanced by a woody undertone, this luxury perfume appeals to the temperamental woman with a forever-oscillating plan of action. A pale-red tonic poured into an intricately shaped bottle, this perfume acts as a tincture for drudgery. Its housed within a cylindrical crimson structure that is reminiscent of the old toffee tins you stored secret messages, your favourite broken earring and magazine cuttings. Forget your deadlines and responsibilities, put on your Red Jeans and take a trip down memory lane.

Top Notes: Peach, Apricot, Freesia and Black Currant;

Middle Notes: Rose, Violet, Lily-of-the-Valley, Water Lily and Ylang-Ylang;

Base Notes: Musk, Vanilla and Sandalwood.

Like the sun across a broad horizon, the oud encompasses all and wraps you in its cloak of pure gold.

This is the moment. This is the passion. This is the scent.

You will find that there are many different fragrances that are used to make the Bakhoor desired. Now your bakhoor could be made up of different kinds of wood that absorbs the different mixtures of essential oils and other ingredients, such as woodchips, a special oil called Oud which the bark as well as the oil from this tree can be very expensive, reaching the thousands in price. You can also use an Agarwood or Aloeswood, which are also very medicinal for your health. Now these can be mixed with other things like resin, Musk oil, Ambergris, sandalwood, some flower oils and other perfumed oil or concentrates with alcohol can be used also, this I saw in Senegal. You have to experiment with different oils and ingredients to get the oil or bakhoor you want to use. By checking here on my site you can order these ingredients to start making your own special bakhoor.

The burning of Frankincense and Myrrh resins, with also Agarwood chips and bakhoor is actually a tradition of the Middle East undoubtedly goes back since probably to the dawn of humanity. Also in addition to this, the burning of fragrant materials to change and enrich the atmosphere if not only just Middle Eastern but is found used worldwide by many or most cultures. So remember it is the combination of oils, chips, Agarwood, and many other fragrances that makes up bakhoor.

Seductive by Guess is a fragrance that embodies femininity, confidence, and seductive charm. Veronique Nyberg is the mastermind behind this alluring scent, which belongs to the Oriental Floral fragrance family.

The fragrance opens with a captivating blend of Bergamot, Black Currant, and Pear, evoking a sense of warmth and spiciness. The heart of the scent is a combination of Jasmine, African Orange Flower, and Orris Root, adding a touch of floral sweetness and earthy richness to the composition. The base notes of Vanille, Olibanum, and Cashmere Wood provide a warm and woody finish that lingers long after the initial application.

Seductive by Guess is a fragrance that appeals to women who are confident in their femininity and unafraid to embrace their seductive side. It is a scent that exudes sensuality and charm, making it perfect for evening wear or special occasions. The combination of warm and spicy, floral, and earthy notes creates a multi-dimensional fragrance that is both alluring and sophisticated.

Top Notes - Cardamom, Mandarin Pulp, Pink Pepper

body_html:

Notes

Lavender, rosemary, mint, juniper, jasmine, carnation, patchouli, amber, oregano, castoreum, cistus, oakmoss, caramel
Description

Unutamam, from first spray, is an intense experience: a whip's lash of lacerating aromatics and florals, defying any attempt at a complacent reaction. Even as the florals grow smoother and lusher, a smoky, industrial undertone grows, with patchouli, labdanum, and castoreum approximating the animalic thrum of petroleum, the rough protection of military-grade leather. Or perhaps your journey into this intriguing and dynamic fragrance takes you in the other direction, to a garden of herbaceous delight and sweet, smooth caramelized amber. After all, the choice is entirely yours- and what an accomplishment that is.

Description

Allure Homme Sport Superleggera by Chanel is a limited-edition release that draws inspiration from the Italian idea of “superleggera,” a philosophy centered on combining lightness with strength. This version reimagines the original Allure Homme Sport with a more refined structure, reducing the heaviness of amber, softening the woods, and introducing a clean patchouli core that drives the composition forward.

The term “Superleggera,” meaning “extremely light” in Italian, comes from an innovative automotive technique developed by Carrozzeria Touring. It involved shaping a thin aluminum body over a rigid steel frame, creating vehicles that were both lightweight and durable—an idea that perfectly mirrors the fragrance’s balance of airy freshness and underlying strength.

Middle Notes: Sandalwood, Iris, Peach and Boronia

Base Notes: Sandalwood, Coconut, Ambergris, Ambrette (Musk Mallow), Balsam Fir and Musk
Description

Radio Bombay by DS & Durga is a unisex oriental-woody scent that captures a modern, textured elegance. Introduced in 2016 and created by perfumer David Seth Moltz, the fragrance opens with a dry, radiant blend of smooth woods and crisp cedar. Third-generation Italian candle and perfume company, Tiziana Terenzi is dedicated to producing some of the world’s most exquisite scents. Tracing their roots back to the family’s production of church votives in the mid-20th century, siblings Tiziana and Paolo launched their line of richly scented candles and perfumes in 2012. The elegant award-winning vessels are all handmade and feature 24k gold detailing. Tiziana Terenzi’s Luna collection is the place of lost memories, wishes and desires. Luna is evocative of far distant memories from childhood, mesmerizing fairytale landscapes, and wild nature". The bottle has a soft matte feel, cylindrical shape and is decorated with an innovative treatment that tints it a pale white colour, exactly like our gorgeous moon. The black and red moon fragrances are housed in red and black glossy-smooth round bottles that mimic the special and rare red and black moons. Porpora is inspired by the magnificence of the famous red moon which sometimes leaps out in a sudden fiery ball of light, from behind the horizon. Alarm, enthralment, excitement and wonder when faced with so much magnificence are all enclosed in this precious creation, which opens with a bold top note provided by the rose absolute, surrounded by wild forest raspberries and spices, such as cinnamon and cloves.

For this man, clothing becomes a jewel-case that serves to reveal the true erotic power of the flesh. Tom of Finland is a breath of fresh air, offering unrestricted access to the immense outdoors, the depths of the forest, with notes of birch leaves, cypress, galbanum and pine at its heart. Straight, gay… These words are irrelevant here. Tom of Finland is beyond sexuality — he is sex, in all its fullness and magnitude, open and erect. Fantasy clings to him like his leather jacket, with suede, musk, and ambergray in the base notes. His belt is fastened with an accord of pepper and spicy-fresh saffron, tangled with a blond suede sensuality on a vanilla bed of tonka bean and iris. This is a man who wants to play, to love, to die and be reborn, again and again. Tom of Finland is a tribute to tomorrow’s glorious possibilities.

title: Nishane Unutamam Extrait de Parfum
body_html:
Type

Extrait de Parfum
Notes

Lavender, rosemary, mint, juniper, jasmine, carnation, patchouli, amber, oregano, castoreum, cistus, oakmoss, caramel
Description

Unutamam, from first spray, is an intense experience: a whip's lash of lacerating aromatics and florals, defying any attempt at a complacent reaction. Even as the florals grow smoother and lusher, a smoky, industrial undertone grows, with patchouli, labdanum, and castoreum approximating the animalic thrum of petroleum, the rough protection of military-grade leather. Or perhaps your journey into this intriguing and dynamic fragrance takes you in the other direction, to a garden of herbaceous delight and sweet, smooth caramelized amber. After all, the choice is entirely yours- and what an accomplishment that is.

Rosemary notes also give a touch of minty aromas, and Sichuan pepper ingredients also provide a burst of animated pepperiness. Finally, base notes of warm amber, vetiver and patchouli provide a strong base to please even the pickiest enthusiasts.
